author: ActARion
body:
const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(r){const t={a:"a",blockquote:"blockquote",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...r.components};return i(e,{children:[i(t.h1,{id:"eine-digitale-bibliothek-von-arbeits--und-sicherheitsanweisungen-aufbauen-die-menschen-tatsächlich-nutzen",children:["Eine digitale Bibliothek von Arbeits- und Sicherheitsanweisungen aufbauen, die Menschen tatsächlich nutzen",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#eine-digitale-bibliothek-von-arbeits--und-sicherheitsanweisungen-aufbauen-die-menschen-tatsächlich-nutzen",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Eine digitale Bibliothek von Arbeits- und Sicherheitsanweisungen kann transformieren, wie Teams in industriellen Umgebungen arbeiten—wenn Menschen sie tatsächlich nutzen. Zu oft werden digitale SOPs und Sicherheitsdokumente erstellt, aber unberührt gelassen, begraben in gemeinsamen Laufwerken oder komplizierten Plattformen. Die echte Herausforderung ist der Aufbau einer digitalen Bibliothek, die zugänglich, relevant und von Technikern, Operatoren und Feldingenieuren vertrauenswürdig ist. Für Operations-, HSE- und Trainingsleiter ist das Ziel klar: Machen Sie jede kritische Anweisung am Bedarfspunkt verfügbar, in einem Format, auf das Teams sich verlassen werden."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"warum-die-meisten-digitalen-bibliotheken-versagen-wert-zu-liefern",children:["Warum die meisten digitalen Bibliotheken versagen, Wert zu liefern",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#warum-die-meisten-digitalen-bibliotheken-versagen-wert-zu-liefern",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Viele Organisationen investieren in digitale Arbeitsanweisungen und AR SOPs, aber die Ergebnisse bleiben oft hinter den Erwartungen zurück. Content wird veraltet, Navigation ist verwirrend und Nutzungsraten sind niedrig. Dies ist nicht nur ein IT-Problem; es betrifft Produktivität, Sicherheit und Compliance."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Häufige Gründe, warum digitale Bibliotheken unterperformen:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Anweisungen sind zu generisch, schwer zu finden oder nicht auf echte Aufgaben zugeschnitten."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Teams haben kein Vertrauen in die Genauigkeit oder Relevanz des Inhalts."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Updates sind langsam und Versionskontrolle ist schwach."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Zugang ist auf Desktops beschränkt oder erfordert umständliche Anmeldungen."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Keine Feedback-Schleife für Teams, um Verbesserungen vorzuschlagen oder Fehler zu melden."}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.p,{children:["Eine Umfrage von 2023 des ",n(t.a,{href:"https://www.nsc.org/workplace/safety-topics/safety-technology",children:"National Safety Council"}),' ergab, dass 62% der industriellen Sicherheitsmanager "veraltete oder schwer zugängliche Verfahren" als ein Top-Betriebsrisiko anführen. Wenn Arbeitsanweisungen nicht genutzt werden, nehmen Vorfälle zu, Onboarding zieht sich hin und Prozessqualität sinkt.']}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"warum-jetzt-qualifikationslücken-sicherheitsanforderungen-und-operativer-druck",children:["Warum jetzt: Qualifikationslücken, Sicherheitsanforderungen und operativer Druck",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#warum-jetzt-qualifikationslücken-sicherheitsanforderungen-und-operativer-druck",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Industrielle Organisationen stehen vor einer Konvergenz von Herausforderungen:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Qualifikationslücken weiten sich aus, während erfahrene Techniker in Rente gehen."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Regulatorische und Kundenanforderungen für nachverfolgbare Compliance steigen."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Produktionsziele sind strenger, mit wenig Spielraum für Fehler."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Teams sind mobiler, mit Arbeit über Anlagen, Standorte und Schichten hinweg."}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Traditionelle Papierhandbücher und statische PDFs können mit diesen Anforderungen nicht Schritt halten. Teams benötigen aktuelle, durchsuchbare und kontextbewusste Anweisungen—verfügbar, wo die Arbeit stattfindet. Digitale Bibliotheken müssen Anleitung auf jedem Gerät liefern, schnelle Updates unterstützen und Nutzungsdaten bereitstellen, um kontinuierliche Verbesserung zu fördern."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"wie-ki--und-ar-gestützte-arbeitsanweisungen-adoption-antreiben",children:["Wie KI- und AR-gestützte Arbeitsanweisungen Adoption antreiben",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#wie-ki--und-ar-gestützte-arbeitsanweisungen-adoption-antreiben",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Der Schlüssel zu einer erfolgreichen digitalen Bibliothek ist nicht nur, Content zu digitalisieren, sondern ihn handlungsfähig und einfach zu nutzen zu machen. KI- und AR-gestützte Arbeitsanweisungen ändern das Spiel, indem sie Informationen im Kontext, on-the-job und im richtigen Format liefern."}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"was-macht-anweisungen-nutzbar-im-feld",children:['Was macht Anweisungen "nutzbar" im Feld',n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#was-macht-anweisungen-nutzbar-im-feld",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Nutzbare Arbeits- und Sicherheitsanweisungen teilen mehrere Eigenschaften:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Durchsuchbar und filterbar:"})," Teams können schnell die richtige SOP oder Sicherheitscheckliste nach Asset, Aufgabe oder Risiko finden."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Schrittweise Anleitung:"})," Klare, prägnante Schritte, unterstützt durch Visuals oder AR-Overlays, reduzieren Mehrdeutigkeit."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Geräteagnostischer Zugang:"})," Anweisungen sind auf Tablets, Smartphones, AR-Brillen oder Desktop verfügbar."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Immer aktuell:"})," Automatisierte Versionskontrolle und sofortige Veröffentlichung genehmigter Änderungen."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Feedback-fähig:"})," Teams können unklare Schritte markieren und Verbesserungen direkt im Workflow vorschlagen."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Durch Einbettung von KI können digitale Bibliotheken relevante Anweisungen basierend auf Kontext empfehlen—wie Jobrolle, Standort oder Ausrüstung. AR fügt eine weitere Ebene hinzu, indem Schritte visuell präsentiert werden und Techniker durch komplexe Verfahren handenfreie führen."}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"beispiel-ar-sops-in-der-ausrüstungswartung",children:["Beispiel: AR SOPs in der Ausrüstungswartung",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#beispiel-ar-sops-in-der-ausrüstungswartung",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Betrachten Sie einen Wartungsleiter, der rotierende Ausrüstung überwacht. Mit KI- und AR-gestützten Arbeitsanweisungen scannen Techniker einen QR-Code an der Maschine und rufen sofort die neueste SOP ab. AR-Overlays zeigen, wo zu inspizieren, was zu prüfen ist und warnen, wenn Schritte übersprungen werden. Wenn sich ein Verfahren ändert, werden Updates automatisch an alle Benutzer gepusht. Das Ergebnis: weniger Ausfallzeiten, weniger Fehler und ein klarer Audit-Trail."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"eine-digitale-bibliothek-aufbauen-der-teams-vertrauen-und-die-sie-nutzen",children:["Eine digitale Bibliothek aufbauen, der Teams vertrauen und die sie nutzen",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#eine-digitale-bibliothek-aufbauen-der-teams-vertrauen-und-die-sie-nutzen",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Um eine digitale Bibliothek zu erstellen, die echten Wert schafft, müssen Führungskräfte sich auf Adoption, Governance und kontinuierliche Verbesserung konzentrieren—nicht nur auf Content-Digitalisierung."}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"schritt-1-kritische-arbeits--und-sicherheitsprozesse-abbilden",children:["Schritt 1: Kritische Arbeits- und Sicherheitsprozesse abbilden",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#schritt-1-kritische-arbeits--und-sicherheitsprozesse-abbilden",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Beginnen Sie mit der Identifizierung der wirkungsvollsten Verfahren—diejenigen, die mit Sicherheit, Compliance oder häufigen Ausfallzeiten verbunden sind. Priorisieren Sie:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Lockout/Tagout-Verfahren"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Enge Räume Zugang"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Vorbeugende Wartungsaufgaben"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Umstellungsroutinen"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Notfallreaktionsprotokolle"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Arbeiten Sie mit erfahrenen Technikern und HSE-Experten zusammen, um stillschweigendes Wissen zu erfassen, das oft nie in Handbücher gelangt."}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"schritt-2-für-nutzbarkeit-und-zugänglichkeit-gestalten",children:["Schritt 2: Für Nutzbarkeit und Zugänglichkeit gestalten",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#schritt-2-für-nutzbarkeit-und-zugänglichkeit-gestalten",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Content muss für schnellen Zugang und Feldeinsatz strukturiert sein. Best Practices umfassen:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Verwenden Sie einfache Sprache und vermeiden Sie Jargon."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Teilen Sie Anweisungen in klare, nummerierte Schritte auf."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Fügen Sie Fotos, Diagramme oder AR-Hinweise hinzu, um Aktionen zu klären."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Taggen Sie Verfahren nach Ausrüstung, Standort, Risikoniveau und Benutzerrolle."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Optimieren Sie für mobile und handenfreie Geräte."}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.p,{children:["Ein ",n(t.a,{href:"https://www2.deloitte.com/us/en/insights/focus/industry-4-0/digital-transformation-in-manufacturing.html",children:"Deloitte-Bericht von 2022"})," hebt hervor, dass digitale Arbeitsanweisungen First-Time-Right-Raten um bis zu 25% verbessern, wenn sie für Feldeinsatzbarkeit gestaltet sind."]}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"schritt-3-schnelle-updates-und-starke-governance-ermöglichen",children:["Schritt 3: Schnelle Updates und starke Governance ermöglichen",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#schritt-3-schnelle-updates-und-starke-governance-ermöglichen",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Veraltete oder widersprüchliche Anweisungen untergraben Vertrauen. Etablieren Sie klares Eigentum für Content-Überprüfung und Genehmigung:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Weisen Sie Prozesseigentümer für jede SOP oder Sicherheitsdokument zu."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Verwenden Sie digitale Workflows für Entwurf, Überprüfung und Veröffentlichung."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Verfolgen Sie Versionsgeschichte und stellen Sie sicher, dass nur die neuesten Anweisungen zugänglich sind."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Planen Sie regelmäßige Audits, um veraltete Inhalte zu entfernen."}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Die Integration mit Asset-Management- oder EHS-Plattformen kann Trigger für Anweisungs-Updates automatisieren, wenn Ausrüstung oder Vorschriften sich ändern."}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"schritt-4-feedback-schleife-mit-teams-schließen",children:["Schritt 4: Feedback-Schleife mit Teams schließen",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#schritt-4-feedback-schleife-mit-teams-schließen",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Ermutigen Sie Techniker und Operatoren, unklare Schritte, fehlende Informationen oder Verbesserungsideen zu melden. Digitale Bibliotheken sollten:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"In-Kontext-Feedback-Einreichungen zulassen."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Vorschläge an Prozesseigentümer zur Überprüfung weiterleiten."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Updates oder Klarstellungen mit allen Benutzern teilen."}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Dies verbessert nicht nur Content-Qualität, sondern fördert auch Engagement und ein Gefühl der Eigentümerschaft."}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"schritt-5-nutzung-und-auswirkungen-messen",children:["Schritt 5: Nutzung und Auswirkungen messen",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#schritt-5-nutzung-und-auswirkungen-messen",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Adoption ist das wahre Maß für Erfolg. Verfolgen Sie wichtige Metriken wie:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Häufigkeit des Anweisungszugriffs nach Team, Asset oder Standort."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Abschlussraten für geführte Verfahren."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Zeitersparnis pro Aufgabe oder Reduktion von Fehlern."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Benutzer-Feedback-Trends und Aktionsraten."}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Überprüfen Sie diese Erkenntnisse regelmäßig, um Training zu zielen, Content zu verfeinern und ROI der Führung zu demonstrieren."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"anwendungsfälle-wo-digitale-bibliotheken-den-meisten-wert-liefern",children:["Anwendungsfälle: wo digitale Bibliotheken den meisten Wert liefern",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#anwendungsfälle-wo-digitale-bibliotheken-den-meisten-wert-liefern",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Digitale Bibliotheken von Arbeits- und Sicherheitsanweisungen beweisen ihren Wert über industrielle Sektoren. Typische wirkungsvolle Szenarien umfassen:"}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"onboarding-und-upskilling-neuer-techniker",children:["Onboarding und Upskilling neuer Techniker",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#onboarding-und-upskilling-neuer-techniker",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Neueinstellungen können auf Schritt-für-Schritt-AR-SOPs für Routineaufgaben zugreifen, was Schattenzeit reduziert und Kompetenz beschleunigt. Ein Prozessindustriekunde reduzierte beispielsweise Onboarding-Zeit um 30%, indem er Kernwartungs- und Sicherheitsanweisungen digitalisierte."}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"reduzierung-von-ausfallzeiten-bei-wartung-und-fehlerbehebung",children:["Reduzierung von Ausfallzeiten bei Wartung und Fehlerbehebung",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#reduzierung-von-ausfallzeiten-bei-wartung-und-fehlerbehebung",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Wenn Ausrüstung ausfällt, zählt jede Minute. Mit KI-gestütztem Suchen finden Techniker relevante Fehlerbehebungsleitfäden oder Reparaturschritte sofort. AR-Overlays führen sie durch komplexe Reparaturen und reduzieren Abhängigkeit von Gedächtnis oder Papierhandbüchern."}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"unterstützung-von-compliance-und-audits",children:["Unterstützung von Compliance und Audits",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#unterstützung-von-compliance-und-audits",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Digital verfolgter SOP-Gebrauch liefert Beweise für regulatorische Audits. Vorgesetzte können verifizieren, dass Teams die neuesten Verfahren befolgten, mit zeitgestempelten Aufzeichnungen und Versionsgeschichte."}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"verbesserung-von-sicherheitsergebnissen",children:["Verbesserung von Sicherheitsergebnissen",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#verbesserung-von-sicherheitsergebnissen",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Zugang zu aktuellen Lockout/Tagout-, engen Räumen- und Notfallreaktionsanweisungen reduziert Vorfallraten. In einem Produktionsfall reduzierten digitale Sicherheitsbibliotheken meldbare Vorfälle um 18% über 12 Monate."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"was-actarion-bringt-bewährte-expertise-in-industrieller-ar-und-ki",children:["Was ActARion bringt: bewährte Expertise in industrieller AR und KI",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#was-actarion-bringt-bewährte-expertise-in-industrieller-ar-und-ki",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"ActARion arbeitet mit Industrielleitern zusammen, um digitale Bibliotheken von Arbeits- und Sicherheitsanweisungen aufzubauen, die Teams tatsächlich nutzen. Unser Ansatz kombiniert:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Tiefes industrielles Prozesswissen, einschließlich HSE-, Wartungs- und Qualitätsdomänen"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Fortgeschrittene KI, um relevante Anweisungen zu empfehlen, zu personalisieren und Anweisungsnutzung zu analysieren"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Augmented Reality-Anleitung für handenfreie, schrittweise Unterstützung im Feld"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Robuste Governance-Workflows für Content-Genauigkeit und Compliance"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Integration mit bestehenden EHS-, LMS- und Asset-Management-Systemen"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Wir arbeiten mit Operations-, HSE- und Trainingsmanagern zusammen, um kritische Prozesse abzubilden, hochwertige digitale SOPs zu gestalten und Adoption über Teams zu fördern. Das Ergebnis: sicherere, produktivere und auditbereite Operationen."}),"
",i(t.blockquote,{children:["
",i(t.p,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Hinweis:"})," ActARion unterstützt sowohl initiale Bibliotheksaufbauten als auch Optimierung bestehender digitaler Anweisungsplattformen. Unsere Methodik ist in Energie, Produktion, Versorgungsunternehmen und Prozessindustrien bewährt."]}),"

",n(t.p,{children:"Een digitale bibliotheek van werk- en veiligheidsvoorschriften kan transformeren hoe teams in industriële omgevingen werken—als mensen deze daadwerkelijk gebruiken. Te vaak worden digitale SOPs en veiligheidsdocumenten gemaakt maar onaangeroerd gelaten, begraven in gedeelde drives of ingewikkelde platforms. De echte uitdaging is het bouwen van een digitale bibliotheek die toegankelijk, relevant en vertrouwd is door technici, operators en veldengineers. Voor operations-, HSE- en trainingsleiders is het doel duidelijk: maak elke kritieke instructie beschikbaar op het punt van behoefte, in een formaat waar teams op zullen vertrouwen."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"waarom-de-meeste-digitale-bibliotheken-falen-om-waarde-te-leveren",children:["Waarom de meeste digitale bibliotheken falen om waarde te leveren",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#waarom-de-meeste-digitale-bibliotheken-falen-om-waarde-te-leveren",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Veel organisaties investeren in digitale werkvoorschriften en AR SOPs, maar de resultaten vallen vaak tegen. Content raakt verouderd, navigatie is verwarrend en gebruikspercentages zijn laag. Dit is niet alleen een IT-probleem; het beïnvloedt productiviteit, veiligheid en compliance."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Veelvoorkomende redenen waarom digitale bibliotheken onderpresteren:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Instructies zijn te generiek, moeilijk te vinden of niet afgestemd op echte taken."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Teams hebben geen vertrouwen in de nauwkeurigheid of relevantie van de content."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Updates zijn traag en versiecontrole is zwak."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Toegang is beperkt tot desktops of vereist omslachtige logins."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Geen feedbackloop voor teams om verbeteringen voor te stellen of fouten te melden."}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.p,{children:["Een onderzoek uit 2023 van de ",n(t.a,{href:"https://www.nsc.org/workplace/safety-topics/safety-technology",children:"National Safety Council"}),' toonde aan dat 62% van de industriële veiligheidsmanagers "verouderde of moeilijk toegankelijke procedures" als een top operationeel risico noemen. Wanneer werkvoorschriften niet worden gebruikt, nemen incidenten toe, trekt onboarding uit en daalt proceskwaliteit.']}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"waarom-nu-vaardigheidsgaten-veiligheidseisen-en-operationele-druk",children:["Waarom nu: vaardigheidsgaten, veiligheidseisen en operationele druk",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#waarom-nu-vaardigheidsgaten-veiligheidseisen-en-operationele-druk",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Industriële organisaties staan voor een convergentie van uitdagingen:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Vaardigheidsgaten worden groter naarmate ervaren technici met pensioen gaan."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Regelgevings- en klantvereisten voor traceerbare compliance stijgen."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Productiedoelen zijn strenger, met weinig ruimte voor fouten."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Teams zijn mobieler, met werk dat plaatsvindt over fabrieken, locaties en ploegen."}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Traditionele papieren handleidingen en statische PDF's kunnen niet bijhouden. Teams vereisen up-to-date, doorzoekbare en contextbewuste instructies—beschikbaar waar het werk gebeurt. Digitale bibliotheken moeten begeleiding leveren op elk apparaat, snelle updates ondersteunen en gebruiksdata bieden om continue verbetering te stimuleren."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"hoe-ai--en-ar-geleide-werkvoorschriften-adoptie-stimuleren",children:["Hoe AI- en AR-geleide werkvoorschriften adoptie stimuleren",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#hoe-ai--en-ar-geleide-werkvoorschriften-adoptie-stimuleren",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"De sleutel tot een succesvolle digitale bibliotheek is niet alleen content digitaliseren, maar het actiegericht en gemakkelijk te gebruiken maken. AI- en AR-geleide werkvoorschriften veranderen het spel door informatie in context, on-the-job en in het juiste formaat te leveren."}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"wat-maakt-instructies-bruikbaar-in-het-veld",children:['Wat maakt instructies "bruikbaar" in het veld',n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#wat-maakt-instructies-bruikbaar-in-het-veld",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Bruikbare werk- en veiligheidsinstructies delen verschillende kenmerken:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Doorzoekbaar en filterbaar:"})," Teams kunnen snel de juiste SOP of veiligheidschecklist vinden op asset, taak of risico."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Stap-voor-stap begeleiding:"})," Duidelijke, beknopte stappen, ondersteund door visuals of AR-overlays, verminderen ambiguïteit."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Apparaatagnostische toegang:"})," Instructies zijn beschikbaar op tablets, smartphones, AR-brillen of desktop."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Altijd up-to-date:"})," Geautomatiseerde versiecontrole en directe publicatie van goedgekeurde wijzigingen."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Feedback-enabled:"})," Teams kunnen onduidelijke stappen markeren en verbeteringen direct binnen de workflow voorstellen."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Door AI in te bedden, kunnen digitale bibliotheken relevante instructies aanbevelen op basis van context—zoals functierol, locatie of apparatuur. AR voegt een extra laag toe door stappen visueel te presenteren, technici door complexe procedures handenvrij te begeleiden."}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"voorbeeld-ar-sops-in-apparatuuronderhoud",children:["Voorbeeld: AR SOPs in apparatuuronderhoud",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#voorbeeld-ar-sops-in-apparatuuronderhoud",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Overweeg een onderhoudsleider die roterende apparatuur bewaakt. ",i(t.h2,{id:"een-digitale-bibliotheek-bouwen-die-teams-vertrouwen-en-gebruiken",children:["Een digitale bibliotheek bouwen die teams vertrouwen en gebruiken",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#een-digitale-bibliotheek-bouwen-die-teams-vertrouwen-en-gebruiken",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Om een digitale bibliotheek te creëren die echte waarde drijft, moeten leiders focussen op adoptie, governance en continue verbetering—niet alleen contentdigitalisatie."}),"

",n(t.p,{children:"Begin met het identificeren van de hoogste-impact procedures—die gekoppeld aan veiligheid, compliance of frequente downtime. Prioriteer:"}),"

",n(t.li,{children:"Lockout/tagout procedures"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Besloten ruimte toegang"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Preventieve onderhoudstaken"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Omschakelroutines"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Noodresponsprotocollen"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Werk samen met ervaren technici en HSE-experts om stilzwijgende kennis vast te leggen die vaak nooit in handleidingen terechtkomt."}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"stap-2-ontwerp-voor-bruikbaarheid-en-toegankelijkheid",children:["Stap 2: Ontwerp voor bruikbaarheid en toegankelijkheid",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#stap-2-ontwerp-voor-bruikbaarheid-en-toegankelijkheid",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Content moet gestructureerd zijn voor snelle toegang en veldgebruik. Best practices zijn:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Gebruik gewone taal en vermijd jargon."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Breek instructies op in duidelijke, genummerde stappen."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Voeg foto's, diagrammen of AR-aanwijzingen toe om acties te verduidelijken."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Tag procedures op apparatuur, locatie, risiconiveau en gebruikersrol."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Optimaliseer voor mobiele en handenvrije apparaten."}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.p,{children:["Een rapport uit 2022 van ",n(t.a,{href:"https://www2.deloitte.com/us/en/insights/focus/industry-4-0/digital-transformation-in-manufacturing.html",children:"Deloitte"})," benadrukt dat digitale werkvoorschriften first-time-right percentages met tot 25% verbeteren wanneer ontworpen voor veldbruikbaarheid."]}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"stap-3-schakel-snelle-updates-en-sterke-governance-in",children:["Stap 3: Schakel snelle updates en sterke governance in",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#stap-3-schakel-snelle-updates-en-sterke-governance-in",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Verouderde of conflicterende instructies eroderen vertrouwen. Stel duidelijk eigendom in voor contentreview en goedkeuring:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Wijs proceseigenaren toe voor elke SOP of veiligheidsdocument."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Gebruik digitale workflows voor opstellen, review en publiceren."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Volg versiegeschiedenis en zorg ervoor dat alleen de nieuwste instructies toegankelijk zijn."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Plan regelmatige audits om verouderde content te verwijderen."}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Integratie met assetmanagement of EHS-platforms kan triggers automatiseren voor instructie-updates wanneer apparatuur of regelgeving verandert."}),"

",n(t.p,{children:"Moedig technici en operators aan om onduidelijke stappen, ontbrekende informatie of verbeterideeën te melden. Digitale bibliotheken zouden moeten:"}),"

",n(t.li,{children:"In-context feedbacksubmissies toestaan."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Suggesties routeren naar proceseigenaren voor review."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Updates of verduidelijkingen delen met alle gebruikers."}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Dit verbetert niet alleen contentkwaliteit, maar stimuleert ook betrokkenheid en een gevoel van eigendom."}),"

",n(t.li,{children:"Voltooiingspercentages voor begeleide procedures."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Tijd bespaard per taak of reductie in fouten."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Gebruikersfeedbacktrends en actiepercentages."}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Bekijk deze inzichten regelmatig om training te richten, content te verfijnen en ROI aan leiderschap te demonstreren."}),"

",n(t.p,{children:"Digitale bibliotheken van werk- en veiligheidsinstructies bewijzen hun waarde over industriële sectoren. Typische high-impact scenario's zijn:"}),"

",n(t.li,{children:"Integratie met bestaande EHS-, LMS- en assetmanagementsystemen"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"We werken samen met operations-, HSE- en trainingsmanagers om kritieke processen in kaart te brengen, hoogwaardige digitale SOPs te ontwerpen en adoptie over teams te stimuleren. Het resultaat: veiligere, productievere en audit-ready operaties."}),"
",i(t.blockquote,{children:["
",i(t.p,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Opmerking:"})," ActARion ondersteunt zowel initiële bibliotheekbouw als optimalisatie van bestaande digitale instructieplatforms. Onze methodologie is bewezen in energie, productie, nutsbedrijven en procesindustrieën."]}),"
"]}),"

body:
const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(a){const t={a:"a",blockquote:"blockquote",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...a.components};return i(e,{children:[i(t.h1,{id:"building-a-digital-library-of-work-and-safety-instructions-that-people-actually-use",children:["Building a digital library of work and safety instructions that people actually use",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#building-a-digital-library-of-work-and-safety-instructions-that-people-actually-use",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"A digital library of work and safety instructions can transform how teams in industrial environments work—if people actually use it. Too often, digital SOPs and safety documents are created but left untouched, buried in shared drives or complicated platforms. The real challenge is building a digital library that is accessible, relevant, and trusted by technicians, operators, and field engineers. For operations, HSE, and training leaders, the goal is clear: make every critical instruction available at the point of need, in a format teams will rely on."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"why-most-digital-libraries-fail-to-deliver-value",children:["Why most digital libraries fail to deliver value",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#why-most-digital-libraries-fail-to-deliver-value",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Many organisations invest in digital work instructions and AR SOPs, but the results often fall short. Content gets outdated, navigation is confusing, and usage rates are low. This is not just an IT issue; it affects productivity, safety, and compliance."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Common reasons digital libraries underperform:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Instructions are too generic, hard to find, or not tailored to real tasks."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Teams lack confidence in the accuracy or relevance of the content."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Updates are slow, and version control is weak."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Access is limited to desktops or requires cumbersome logins."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"No feedback loop for teams to suggest improvements or report errors."}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.p,{children:["A 2023 survey from the ",n(t.a,{href:"https://www.nsc.org/workplace/safety-topics/safety-technology",children:"National Safety Council"}),' found that 62% of industrial safety managers cite "out-of-date or hard-to-access procedures" as a top operational risk. When work instructions aren't used, incidents increase, onboarding drags out, and process quality declines.']}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"why-now-skills-gaps-safety-demands-and-operational-pressure",children:["Why now: Skills gaps, safety demands, and operational pressure",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#why-now-skills-gaps-safety-demands-and-operational-pressure",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Industrial organisations are facing a convergence of challenges:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Skills gaps are widening as experienced technicians retire."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Regulatory and client demands for traceable compliance are rising."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Production targets are tighter, with little room for error."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Teams are more mobile, with work happening across plants, sites, and shifts."}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Traditional paper manuals and static PDFs cannot keep up with these needs. Teams require up-to-date, searchable, and context-aware instructions—available where the work happens. Digital libraries must deliver guidance on any device, support rapid updates, and provide usage data to drive continuous improvement."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"how-ai-and-arguided-work-instructions-drive-adoption",children:["How AI and AR–guided work instructions drive adoption",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-ai-and-arguided-work-instructions-drive-adoption",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"The key to a successful digital library is not just digitising content, but making it actionable and easy to use. AI and AR–guided work instructions change the game by delivering information in context, on the job, and in the right format."}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"what-makes-instructions-usable-in-the-field",children:['What makes instructions "usable" in the field',n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#what-makes-instructions-usable-in-the-field",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Usable work and safety instructions share several characteristics:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Searchable and filterable:"})," Teams can quickly find the right SOP or safety checklist by asset, task, or risk."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Step-by-step guidance:"})," Clear, concise steps, supported by visuals or AR overlays, reduce ambiguity."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Device-agnostic access:"})," Instructions are available on tablets, smartphones, AR glasses, or desktop."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Always up to date:"})," Automated version control and instant publishing of approved changes."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Feedback-enabled:"})," Teams can flag unclear steps and suggest improvements directly within the workflow."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"By embedding AI, digital libraries can recommend relevant instructions based on context—such as job role, location, or equipment. AR adds another layer by presenting steps visually, guiding technicians through complex procedures hands-free."}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"example-ar-sops-in-equipment-maintenance",children:["Example: AR SOPs in equipment maintenance",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#example-ar-sops-in-equipment-maintenance",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Consider a maintenance lead overseeing rotating equipment. With AI and AR–guided work instructions, technicians scan a QR code at the machine, instantly pulling up the latest SOP. AR overlays show where to inspect, what to check, and alert if steps are skipped. If a procedure changes, updates push automatically to all users. The result: less downtime, fewer errors, and a clear audit trail."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"building-a-digital-library-that-teams-trust-and-use",children:["Building a digital library that teams trust and use",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#building-a-digital-library-that-teams-trust-and-use",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"To create a digital library that drives real value, leaders must focus on adoption, governance, and continuous improvement—not just content digitisation."}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"step-1-map-critical-work-and-safety-processes",children:["Step 1: Map critical work and safety processes",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#step-1-map-critical-work-and-safety-processes",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Start by identifying the highest-impact procedures—those tied to safety, compliance, or frequent downtime. Prioritise:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Lockout/tagout procedures"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Confined space entry"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Preventive maintenance tasks"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Changeover routines"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Emergency response protocols"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Work with experienced technicians and HSE experts to capture tacit knowledge that often never makes it into manuals."}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"step-2-design-for-usability-and-accessibility",children:["Step 2: Design for usability and accessibility",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#step-2-design-for-usability-and-accessibility",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Content must be structured for fast access and field use. Best practices include:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Use plain language and avoid jargon."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Break instructions into clear, numbered steps."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Add photos, diagrams, or AR cues to clarify actions."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Tag procedures by equipment, location, risk level, and user role."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Optimise for mobile and hands-free devices."}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.p,{children:["A 2022 ",n(t.a,{href:"https://www2.deloitte.com/us/en/insights/focus/industry-4-0/digital-transformation-in-manufacturing.html",children:"Deloitte report"})," highlights that digital work instructions improve first-time-right rates by up to 25% when designed for field usability."]}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"step-3-enable-rapid-updates-and-strong-governance",children:["Step 3: Enable rapid updates and strong governance",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#step-3-enable-rapid-updates-and-strong-governance",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Outdated or conflicting instructions erode trust. Establish clear ownership for content review and approval:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Assign process owners for each SOP or safety document."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Use digital workflows for drafting, review, and publishing."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Track version history and ensure only the latest instructions are accessible."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Schedule regular audits to remove obsolete content."}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Integrating with asset management or EHS platforms can automate triggers for instruction updates when equipment or regulations change."}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"step-4-close-the-feedback-loop-with-teams",children:["Step 4: Close the feedback loop with teams",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#step-4-close-the-feedback-loop-with-teams",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Encourage technicians and operators to report unclear steps, missing information, or improvement ideas. Digital libraries should:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Allow in-context feedback submissions."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Route suggestions to process owners for review."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Share updates or clarifications with all users."}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"This not only improves content quality but also drives engagement and a sense of ownership."}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"step-5-measure-usage-and-impact",children:["Step 5: Measure usage and impact",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#step-5-measure-usage-and-impact",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Adoption is the true measure of success. Track key metrics such as:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Frequency of instruction access by team, asset, or location."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Completion rates for guided procedures."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Time saved per task or reduction in errors."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"User feedback trends and action rates."}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Regularly review these insights to target training, refine content, and demonstrate ROI to leadership."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"use-cases-where-digital-libraries-deliver-the-most-value",children:["Use cases: Where digital libraries deliver the most value",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#use-cases-where-digital-libraries-deliver-the-most-value",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Digital libraries of work and safety instructions are proving their value across industrial sectors. Typical high-impact scenarios include:"}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"onboarding-and-upskilling-new-technicians",children:["Onboarding and upskilling new technicians",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#onboarding-and-upskilling-new-technicians",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"New hires can access step-by-step AR SOPs for routine tasks, reducing shadowing time and accelerating competency. For example, a process industry client reduced onboarding time by 30% by digitising core maintenance and safety instructions."}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"reducing-downtime-in-maintenance-and-troubleshooting",children:["Reducing downtime in maintenance and troubleshooting",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#reducing-downtime-in-maintenance-and-troubleshooting",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"When equipment fails, every minute counts. With AI-powered search, technicians find relevant troubleshooting guides or repair steps instantly. AR overlays walk them through complex fixes, reducing reliance on memory or paper manuals."}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"supporting-compliance-and-audits",children:["Supporting compliance and audits",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#supporting-compliance-and-audits",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Digitally tracked SOP usage provides evidence for regulatory audits. Supervisors can verify that teams followed the latest procedures, with time-stamped records and version history."}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"improving-safety-outcomes",children:["Improving safety outcomes",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#improving-safety-outcomes",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Access to up-to-date lockout/tagout, confined space, and emergency response instructions reduces incident rates. In one manufacturing case, digital safety libraries cut reportable incidents by 18% over 12 months."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"what-actarion-brings-proven-expertise-in-industrial-ar-and-ai",children:["What ActARion brings: Proven expertise in industrial AR and AI",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#what-actarion-brings-proven-expertise-in-industrial-ar-and-ai",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"ActARion works with industrial leaders to build digital libraries of work and safety instructions that teams actually use. Our approach combines:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Deep industrial process knowledge, including HSE, maintenance, and quality domains"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Advanced AI to recommend, personalise, and analyse instruction usage"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Augmented reality guidance for hands-free, step-by-step support in the field"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Robust governance workflows for content accuracy and compliance"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Integration with existing EHS, LMS, and asset management systems"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"We partner with operations, HSE, and training managers to map critical processes, design high-utility digital SOPs, and drive adoption across teams. The result: safer, more productive, and audit-ready operations."}),"
",i(t.blockquote,{children:["
",i(t.p,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Note:"})," ActARion supports both initial library builds and optimisation of existing digital instruction platforms. Our methodology is proven in energy, manufacturing, utilities, and process industries."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"explore-what-this-looks-like-in-your-organisation",children:["Explore what this looks like in your organisation",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#explore-what-this-looks-like-in-your-organisation",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"If you want to see how a digital library of work and safety instructions can boost productivity, compliance, and safety in your environment, schedule a discovery call with ActARion. This session is exploratory and tailored to your processes—no commitment required."}),"
",i(t.p,{children:["Learn more about ",n(t.a,{href:"/en/use-cases",children:"AI and AR–guided work instructions"})," or see ",n(t.a,{href:"/en/use-cases/ar-training-and-onboarding-for-industrial-teams",children:"AR onboarding for technicians"})," in action. For further reading, the ",n(t.a,{href:"https://www.nsc.org/workplace/safety-topics/safety-technology",children:"National Safety Council's safety technology resources"})," provide additional context on digital adoption in industry."]})]})}return{default:function(e={}){const{wrapper:i}=e.components||{};return i?n(i,{...e,children:n(_createMdxContent,{...e})}):_createMdxContent(e)}};

title: Die richtige Hardware wählen: Smart Glasses, Tablets oder Smartphones für AR am Arbeitsplatz
description: Ein praktischer Leitfaden für Operations-, HSE- und Trainingsmanager zur Auswahl der besten AR-Hardware—Smart Glasses, Tablets oder Smartphones—für industrielle Umgebungen.

image.alt: Die richtige Hardware wählen: Smart Glasses, Tablets oder Smartphones für AR am Arbeitsplatz

author: ActARion
body:
const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:r}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(i){const t={a:"a",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...i.components};return r(e,{children:[r(t.h1,{id:"die-richtige-hardware-wählen-smart-glasses-tablets-oder-smartphones-für-ar-am-arbeitsplatz",children:["Die richtige Hardware wählen: Smart Glasses, Tablets oder Smartphones für AR am Arbeitsplatz",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#die-richtige-hardware-wählen-smart-glasses-tablets-oder-smartphones-für-ar-am-arbeitsplatz",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Die Auswahl der richtigen Hardware für AR am Arbeitsplatz—Smart Glasses, Tablets oder Smartphones—beeinflusst direkt Produktivität, Sicherheit und Qualität in industriellen Umgebungen. Während AR- und KI-gestützte Arbeitsanweisungen Standard in Wartung, Inspektionen, Training und Sicherheit werden, stehen Operations-Führungskräfte vor einer kritischen Entscheidung: Welches Gerät liefert die besten Ergebnisse für ihre Teams und Prozesse?"}),"
",r(t.h2,{id:"ar-hardware-optionen-vervielfachen-sichund-damit-auch-die-auswahlmöglichkeiten",children:["AR-Hardware-Optionen vervielfachen sich—und damit auch die Auswahlmöglichkeiten",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#ar-hardware-optionen-vervielfachen-sichund-damit-auch-die-auswahlmöglichkeiten",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Industrieunternehmen bewegen sich schnell, um Prozesse zu digitalisieren und AR-gestützte Arbeitsanweisungen einzuführen. Die Hardwarelandschaft ist jedoch komplex. Smart Glasses versprechen handenfreie Bedienung. Tablets bieten größere Bildschirme und Flexibilität. Smartphones sind überall und vertraut. Jedes Gerät hat Stärken und Kompromisse."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Die richtige AR-Hardware zu wählen geht nicht darum, Trends zu folgen oder das neueste Gadget zu wählen. Es geht darum, Gerätefähigkeiten an Ihre Umgebung, Aufgabenanforderungen, Sicherheitsstandards und Workforce-Bedürfnisse anzupassen."}),"
",r(t.h2,{id:"der-fall-für-veränderung-warum-hardwareauswahl-jetzt-wichtig-ist",children:["Der Fall für Veränderung: warum Hardwareauswahl jetzt wichtig ist",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#der-fall-für-veränderung-warum-hardwareauswahl-jetzt-wichtig-ist",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Industriesektoren stehen unter Druck, Effizienz zu steigern, Fehler zu reduzieren und Teams weiterzubilden—oft mit weniger Ressourcen und strengeren Compliance-Anforderungen. Traditionelle papierbasierte SOPs und manuelles Training sind zu langsam und fehleranfällig für das Tempo von heute."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Digitale Arbeitsanweisungen, geliefert über AR und KI, helfen, diese Herausforderungen anzugehen durch:"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Standardisierung von Verfahren über Schichten und Standorte"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Ermöglichen von Echtzeit-Anleitung und Remote-Support"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Reduzierung von Onboarding-Zeit und Qualifikationslücken"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Verbesserung der Datenerfassung für Compliance und Audits"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Aber die Auswirkung digitaler Anweisungen hängt davon ab, wie Teams darauf zugreifen und damit interagieren. Hardware, die umständlich, unsicher oder ungeeignet für die Umgebung ist, kann selbst die beste AR-Content untergraben."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Aktuelle Forschung von PwC und dem Fraunhofer-Institut hebt hervor, dass Gerätenutzerfreundlichkeit und Aufgabenpassung sowohl Sicherheit als auch Produktivität in industriellen AR-Bereitstellungen signifikant beeinflussen (PwC, 2023; Fraunhofer, 2022)."}),"
",r(t.h2,{id:"schlüsselanforderungen-für-ar-hardware-in-industriellen-umgebungen",children:["Schlüsselanforderungen für AR-Hardware in industriellen Umgebungen",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#schlüsselanforderungen-für-ar-hardware-in-industriellen-umgebungen",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Bevor Sie Geräte vergleichen, klären Sie, was für Ihren Anwendungsfall am wichtigsten ist. Für die meisten industriellen Operationen sind folgende Anforderungen kritisch:"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Sicherheit und Compliance:"})," Geräte dürfen keine Gefahren schaffen. ATEX- oder IECEx-Zertifizierung kann in explosionsgefährdeten Umgebungen erforderlich sein."]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Handenfreie Bedienung:"})," Wesentlich für viele Wartungs-, Inspektions- und Montageaufgaben."]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Haltbarkeit:"})," Geräte müssen Staub, Feuchtigkeit, Stürze und Temperaturextreme aushalten."]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Batterielaufzeit:"})," Ausreichend für eine volle Schicht, besonders für Feldingenieure und Remote-Standorte."]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Benutzerfreundlichkeit:"})," Minimale Schulung erforderlich; intuitive Schnittstellen sind wesentlich für Adoption."]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Konnektivität:"})," Zuverlässiges Wi-Fi, LTE oder 5G für Echtzeit-AR-Content und Remote-Support."]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Integration:"})," Kompatibilität mit bestehenden Systemen (CMMS, LMS, EHS-Plattformen)."]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Datensicherheit:"})," Compliance mit Corporate-IT- und Datenschutzrichtlinien."]}),"
"]}),"
",r(t.h2,{id:"ar-hardware-vergleichen-smart-glasses-tablets-und-smartphones",children:["AR-Hardware vergleichen: Smart Glasses, Tablets und Smartphones",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#ar-hardware-vergleichen-smart-glasses-tablets-und-smartphones",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Jede Hardware-Option bringt deutliche Vorteile und Einschränkungen. Die beste Wahl hängt von Ihren Workflows, Umgebungen und Prioritäten ab."}),"
",r(t.h3,{id:"smart-glasses-handenfreie-aber-mit-vorbehalten",children:["Smart Glasses: handenfreie, aber mit Vorbehalten",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#smart-glasses-handenfreie-aber-mit-vorbehalten",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:n(t.strong,{children:"Stärken:"})}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Echte handenfreie Bedienung—kritisch für Aufgaben, die beide Hände erfordern (z.B. Elektroarbeiten, Montage, Leitern besteigen)."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Heads-up-Display legt AR-Anweisungen direkt ins Sichtfeld."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Sprach- oder Gestensteuerung reduziert Bedarf an physischer Interaktion."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Einige Modelle (z.B. RealWear, Vuzix) bieten industrielle Robustheit und ATEX-Zertifizierung."}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:n(t.strong,{children:"Einschränkungen:"})}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Kleinere Anzeigefläche kann Detail oder Komplexität von Anweisungen begrenzen."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Komfort und Passform können bei langen Schichten oder mit PSA ein Problem sein (z.B. Schutzhelme, Schutzbrillen)."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Einige Modelle haben begrenzte App-Kompatibilität oder erfordern benutzerdefinierte Entwicklung."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Höhere Anschaffungskosten als Tablets oder Telefone; Geräteverwaltung kann komplex sein."}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:n(t.strong,{children:"Am besten für:"})}),"

const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(r){const a={a:"a",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...r.components};return i(e,{children:[i(a.h1,{id:"de-juiste-hardware-kiezen-slimme-brillen-tablets-of-smartphones-voor-ar-op-het-werk",children:["De juiste hardware kiezen: slimme brillen, tablets of smartphones voor AR op het werk",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#de-juiste-hardware-kiezen-slimme-brillen-tablets-of-smartphones-voor-ar-op-het-werk",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Het selecteren van de juiste hardware voor AR op het werk—slimme brillen, tablets of smartphones—heeft direct invloed op productiviteit, veiligheid en kwaliteit in industriële omgevingen. Naarmate AR- en AI-geleide werkvoorschriften standaard worden in onderhoud, inspecties, training en veiligheid, staan operations-leiders voor een kritieke beslissing: welk apparaat levert de beste resultaten voor hun teams en processen?"}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"ar-hardwareopties-vermenigvuldigenen-zo-ook-de-keuzes",children:["AR-hardwareopties vermenigvuldigen—en zo ook de keuzes",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#ar-hardwareopties-vermenigvuldigenen-zo-ook-de-keuzes",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"

Slimme brillen beloven handenvrije bediening. Tablets bieden grotere schermen en flexibiliteit. Smartphones zijn overal en vertrouwd. Elk apparaat heeft sterke punten en afwegingen."}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"De juiste AR-hardware kiezen gaat niet om trends volgen of het nieuwste gadget kiezen. Het gaat om het matchen van apparaatcapaciteiten aan uw omgeving, taakvereisten, veiligheidsnormen en workforce behoeften."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"het-geval-voor-verandering-waarom-hardwarekeuze-nu-belangrijk-is",children:["Het geval voor verandering: waarom hardwarekeuze nu belangrijk is",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#het-geval-voor-verandering-waarom-hardwarekeuze-nu-belangrijk-is",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Industriële sectoren staan onder druk om efficiëntie te verhogen, fouten te verminderen en teams bij te scholen—vaak met minder middelen en strengere compliance-eisen. Traditionele papieren SOPs en handmatige training zijn te traag en foutgevoelig voor het tempo van vandaag."}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Digitale werkvoorschriften, geleverd via AR en AI, helpen deze uitdagingen aan te pakken door:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Procedures te standaardiseren over ploegen en locaties"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Real-time begeleiding en remote support mogelijk te maken"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Onboardingtijd en vaardigheidsgaten te verminderen"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Gegevenscapture te verbeteren voor compliance en audits"}),"
"]}),"

",n(a.p,{children:"Recent onderzoek van PwC en het Fraunhofer Institute benadrukt dat apparaatbruikbaarheid en taakfit significant zowel veiligheid als productiviteit beïnvloeden in industriële AR-implementaties (PwC, 2023; Fraunhofer, 2022)."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"belangrijke-vereisten-voor-ar-hardware-in-industriële-omgevingen",children:["Belangrijke vereisten voor AR-hardware in industriële omgevingen",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#belangrijke-vereisten-voor-ar-hardware-in-industriële-omgevingen",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Voordat u apparaten vergelijkt, verduidelijk wat het belangrijkst is voor uw use case. Voor de meeste industriële operaties zijn de volgende vereisten cruciaal:"}),"

",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Handenvrije bediening:"})," Essentieel voor veel onderhouds-, inspectie- en montagetaken."]}),"

"]}),"

const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(r){const a={a:"a",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...r.components};return i(e,{children:[i(a.h1,{id:"choosing-the-right-hardware-smart-glasses-tablets-or-smartphones-for-ar-on-the-job",children:["Choosing the right hardware: smart glasses, tablets or smartphones for AR on the job",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#choosing-the-right-hardware-smart-glasses-tablets-or-smartphones-for-ar-on-the-job",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Selecting the right hardware for AR on the job—smart glasses, tablets, or smartphones—directly impacts productivity, safety, and quality in industrial environments. As AR and AI–guided work instructions become standard in maintenance, inspections, training, and safety, operations leaders face a critical decision: which device delivers the best results for their teams and processes?"}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"ar-hardware-options-are-multiplyingand-so-are-the-choices",children:["AR hardware options are multiplying—and so are the choices",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#ar-hardware-options-are-multiplyingand-so-are-the-choices",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Industrial companies are moving quickly to digitize processes and introduce AR–guided work instructions. The hardware landscape, however, is complex. Smart glasses promise hands-free operation. Tablets offer larger screens and flexibility. Smartphones are everywhere and familiar. Each device has strengths and trade-offs."}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Choosing the right AR hardware is not about following trends or picking the latest gadget. It is about matching device capabilities to your environment, task requirements, safety standards, and workforce needs."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"the-case-for-change-why-hardware-choice-matters-now",children:["The case for change: why hardware choice matters now",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#the-case-for-change-why-hardware-choice-matters-now",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Industrial sectors are under pressure to boost efficiency, reduce errors, and upskill teams—often with fewer resources and tighter compliance demands. Traditional paper SOPs and manual training are too slow and error-prone for today’s pace."}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Digital work instructions, delivered through AR and AI, help address these challenges by:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Standardizing procedures across shifts and sites"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Enabling real-time guidance and remote support"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Reducing onboarding time and skill gaps"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Improving data capture for compliance and audits"}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"But the impact of digital instructions depends on how teams access and interact with them. Hardware that is awkward, unsafe, or ill-suited to the environment can undermine even the best AR content."}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Recent research from PwC and the Fraunhofer Institute highlights that device usability and task fit significantly affect both safety and productivity in industrial AR deployments (PwC, 2023; Fraunhofer, 2022)."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"key-requirements-for-ar-hardware-in-industrial-environments",children:["Key requirements for AR hardware in industrial environments",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#key-requirements-for-ar-hardware-in-industrial-environments",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Before comparing devices, clarify what matters most for your use case. For most industrial operations, the following requirements are critical:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Safety and compliance:"})," Devices must not create hazards. ATEX or IECEx certification may be required in explosive environments."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Hands-free operation:"})," Essential for many maintenance, inspection, and assembly tasks."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Durability:"})," Devices must withstand dust, moisture, drops, and temperature extremes."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Battery life:"})," Sufficient for a full shift, especially for field engineers and remote sites."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Ease of use:"})," Minimal training required; intuitive interfaces are essential for adoption."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Connectivity:"})," Reliable Wi-Fi, LTE, or 5G for real-time AR content and remote support."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Integration:"})," Compatibility with existing systems (CMMS, LMS, EHS platforms)."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Data security:"})," Compliance with corporate IT and data protection policies."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"comparing-ar-hardware-smart-glasses-tablets-and-smartphones",children:["Comparing AR hardware: smart glasses, tablets, and smartphones",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#comparing-ar-hardware-smart-glasses-tablets-and-smartphones",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Each hardware option brings distinct advantages and limitations. The best choice depends on your workflows, environments, and priorities."}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"smart-glasses-hands-free-but-with-caveats",children:["Smart glasses: hands-free, but with caveats",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#smart-glasses-hands-free-but-with-caveats",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:n(a.strong,{children:"Strengths:"})}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"True hands-free operation—critical for tasks that require both hands (e.g., electrical work, assembly, climbing ladders)."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Heads-up display overlays AR instructions directly in the field of view."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Voice or gesture controls reduce need for physical interaction."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Some models (e.g., RealWear, Vuzix) offer industrial-grade ruggedness and ATEX certification."}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:n(a.strong,{children:"Limitations:"})}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Smaller display area can limit the detail or complexity of instructions."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Comfort and fit can be an issue for long shifts or with PPE (e.g., hard hats, safety glasses)."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Some models have limited app compatibility or require custom development."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Higher upfront cost than tablets or phones; device management can be complex."}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:n(a.strong,{children:"Best for:"})}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Maintenance, inspection, or repair tasks where hands-free is mandatory."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Environments where safety or hygiene prohibits hand-held devices."}),"
",i(a.li,{children:["Remote expert support (see ",n(a.a,{href:"/en/use-cases/ar-remote-expert-support-for-corrective-maintenance",children:"remote support for field engineers"}),")."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"tablets-flexible-and-familiar",children:["Tablets: flexible and familiar",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#tablets-flexible-and-familiar",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:n(a.strong,{children:"Strengths:"})}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["

",n(a.li,{children:"Good for group training, collaborative troubleshooting, or work in pairs."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Ruggedized versions available for harsh environments (e.g., Panasonic Toughpad, Zebra ET series)."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Familiar interface—most teams have experience with tablets."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Easier to annotate images or capture data using touch."}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:n(a.strong,{children:"Limitations:"})}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Not hands-free; may require stands, mounts, or frequent hand-offs."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Can be cumbersome in tight spaces or when climbing."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"More prone to drops or accidental damage if not ruggedized."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"May not be suitable in ATEX or high-risk zones unless certified."}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:n(a.strong,{children:"Best for:"})}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Training, onboarding, or SOP reviews where interactivity and screen size matter."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Step-by-step assembly or quality checks at workstations."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Field service where documentation is required, but hands-free is not essential."}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"smartphones-portable-and-accessible",children:["Smartphones: portable and accessible",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#smartphones-portable-and-accessible",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:n(a.strong,{children:"Strengths:"})}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["

",n(a.li,{children:"Good for quick reference, checklists, or capturing photos and video."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Many ruggedized or ATEX-certified industrial models available (e.g., i.safe MOBILE, Sonim)."}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:n(a.strong,{children:"Limitations:"})}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Small screen size can limit AR experience—complex diagrams or 3D models are harder to view."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Not hands-free; frequent handling may interrupt tasks."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Battery life may be limited under heavy AR or video use."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Security and device management can be a challenge if using personal devices."}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:n(a.strong,{children:"Best for:"})}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Fast access to digital work instructions or checklists."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Data capture (photos, voice notes) in inspections or audits."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Environments where tablets or glasses are impractical."}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"real-world-scenarios-matching-hardware-to-process",children:["Real-world scenarios: matching hardware to process",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#real-world-scenarios-matching-hardware-to-process",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"No single device fits every industrial scenario. Effective AR deployments often mix hardware types, matched to specific workflows."}),"

",i(a.ul,{children:["
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Smart glasses"})," excel for hands-free inspection, guided repair, and remote expert support."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Tablets"})," are useful for troubleshooting complex systems where large diagrams or manuals are needed."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Smartphones"})," provide quick reference for SOPs or to document issues."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"operator-training-and-onboarding",children:["Operator training and onboarding",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#operator-training-and-onboarding",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Tablets"})," support interactive, group-based AR training and onboarding for new technicians (",n(a.a,{href:"/en/use-cases/ar-training-and-onboarding-for-industrial-teams",children:"AR onboarding for technicians"}),")."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Smart glasses"})," allow new hires to shadow experienced operators while receiving live AR prompts."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Smartphones"})," offer self-paced instruction and easy access to microlearning content."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"inspections-and-safety-audits",children:["Inspections and safety audits",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#inspections-and-safety-audits",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Smart glasses"})," enable hands-free inspection with voice-activated data capture and photo documentation."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Tablets"})," are effective for supervisors conducting detailed audits and entering corrective actions."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Smartphones"})," allow distributed teams to complete checklists and submit findings from the field."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"assembly-and-quality-control",children:["Assembly and quality control",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#assembly-and-quality-control",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Smart glasses"})," guide operators through complex assembly steps, reducing errors and improving consistency."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Tablets"})," support visual quality checks and review of 3D models."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Smartphones"})," can capture photos of completed work for traceability."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"addressing-key-objections-and-practical-limitations",children:["Addressing key objections and practical limitations",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#addressing-key-objections-and-practical-limitations",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Industrial decision makers often raise valid concerns about AR hardware adoption:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Device comfort and fatigue:"})," Smart glasses may cause discomfort during long shifts or with PPE. Pilot tests and user feedback are essential before large-scale rollout."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Content adaptation:"})," AR work instructions must be optimized for each device type—too much detail on a small screen can frustrate users."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"IT and security:"})," Device management, user authentication, and data protection must align with corporate policies. Many rugged devices support enterprise MDM solutions."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Cost and ROI:"})," While smart glasses have higher upfront costs, they can deliver rapid ROI in hands-free, high-value tasks. Tablets and smartphones offer lower entry costs but may need frequent replacement in harsh environments."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Change management:"})," Successful adoption requires clear communication, training, and pilot programs to build trust and gather feedback from technicians and operators."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"how-actarion-supports-hardware-selection-and-deployment",children:["How ActARion supports hardware selection and deployment",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-actarion-supports-hardware-selection-and-deployment",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"ActARion’s approach is hardware-agnostic. Our AI and AR–guided work instructions platform supports all major smart glasses, tablets, and smartphones used in industrial settings. We work with you to:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Assess task and environment requirements to recommend the most effective device mix."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Pilot AR SOPs across different hardware with real teams and real tasks."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Optimize digital work instructions for each device type—ensuring clarity, usability, and safety."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Integrate with your existing IT, EHS, and maintenance systems for seamless workflows."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Support change management, training, and feedback collection to ensure adoption."}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Our team brings deep experience in industrial change projects, safety standards, and digital transformation. We help you move beyond “one size fits all” and deliver measurable gains in productivity, compliance, and workforce readiness."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"explore-the-right-ar-hardware-mix-for-your-environment",children:["Explore the right AR hardware mix for your environment",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#explore-the-right-ar-hardware-mix-for-your-environment",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Choosing the right AR hardware—smart glasses, tablets, or smartphones—can transform productivity, safety, and training in your operations. The ideal solution fits your processes, teams, and safety requirements."}),"
",i(a.p,{children:["To explore how ActARion can help you pilot the best device mix for your use cases, ",n(a.a,{href:"/en/contact",children:"schedule a discovery call"})," or ",n(a.a,{href:"/en/contact",children:"request a tailored AR hardware checklist"}),". See how leading companies are deploying AR SOPs in ",n(a.a,{href:"/en/use-cases/ar-preventive-maintenance-with-data-driven-insights",children:"industrial maintenance environments"}),"."]}),"
",i(a.p,{children:["For an in-depth industry perspective, see the ",n(a.a,{href:"https://www.pwc.com/gx/en/industries/industrial-manufacturing/publications/augmented-reality.html",children:"PwC report on AR hardware in industry"}),"."]})]})}return{default:function(e={}){const{wrapper:i}=e.components||{};return i?n(i,{...e,children:n(_createMdxContent,{...e})}):_createMdxContent(e)}};
