title: How AR and AI help capture expert knowledge before it walks out of the door
description: Industrial leaders: see how AR and AI-guided work instructions capture expert knowledge, reduce training time, and protect quality as experienced staff retire.

image.alt: How AR and AI help capture expert knowledge before it walks out of the door

author: ActARion
body:
const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(a){const r={a:"a",blockquote:"blockquote",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...a.components};return i(e,{children:[i(r.h1,{id:"how-ar-and-ai-help-capture-expert-knowledge-before-it-walks-out-of-the-door",children:["How AR and AI help capture expert knowledge before it walks out of the door",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-ar-and-ai-help-capture-expert-knowledge-before-it-walks-out-of-the-door",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Industrial companies face a critical risk: experienced technicians and engineers are retiring or moving on, taking decades of practical knowledge with them. Capturing this expertise before it walks out of the door is now a top priority for operations, maintenance, and HSE leaders. AI and AR-guided work instructions offer a direct, practical way to digitize expert knowledge, reduce onboarding times, and maintain safety and productivity standards as teams change."}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"why-expert-knowledge-loss-is-an-urgent-operational-risk",children:["Why expert knowledge loss is an urgent operational risk",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#why-expert-knowledge-loss-is-an-urgent-operational-risk",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Many industrial sectors—manufacturing, energy, chemicals, utilities—are seeing a wave of retirements and turnover. According to the US Bureau of Labor Statistics, almost 25% of the manufacturing workforce is over 55, and the trend is similar in Europe and Asia. As experienced staff leave, the risk isn’t just slower onboarding for new hires. Companies face:"}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",n(r.li,{children:"Increased safety incidents due to gaps in tacit knowledge"}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Lower productivity as less experienced teams struggle to troubleshoot"}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"More downtime from avoidable errors or missed steps"}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Reduced compliance with critical procedures (SOPs, quality checks, safety routines)"}),"
"]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Verbal handover, paper checklists, and job shadowing are no longer enough. The complexity and variability of industrial operations demand a more robust, scalable approach."}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"whats-changing-new-pressures-and-expectations",children:["What’s changing: new pressures and expectations",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#whats-changing-new-pressures-and-expectations",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Three trends make knowledge capture more urgent and challenging:"}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Higher turnover and skill gaps:"})," Younger technicians have different expectations for learning, and fewer want to spend years “learning by osmosis.”"]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"More complex assets and processes:"})," Modern equipment and compliance standards require precise, up-to-date procedures."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Regulatory and customer demands:"})," Auditable, standardized SOPs are now baseline expectations in most regulated industries."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"At the same time, digital transformation is no longer optional. Operations managers and L&D leaders are expected to demonstrate measurable improvements in training time, error rates, and compliance."}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"the-limits-of-traditional-knowledge-transfer-methods",children:["The limits of traditional knowledge transfer methods",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#the-limits-of-traditional-knowledge-transfer-methods",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Conventional approaches—mentoring, shadowing, written SOPs—leave critical gaps:"}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Tacit knowledge isn’t captured:"})," Experts know the “why” and “how” behind each step, but this rarely makes it into manuals."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Procedures become outdated:"})," Paper SOPs are hard to update and distribute at scale."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Learning is slow and inconsistent:"})," New hires must absorb information passively, leading to variable results."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"These gaps are visible in onboarding metrics, incident reports, and quality audits. Companies need a way to digitize not just the “what” but also the “how” and “why” of expert work."}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"how-ai-and-ar-help-capture-and-transfer-expert-knowledge",children:["How AI and AR help capture and transfer expert knowledge",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-ai-and-ar-help-capture-and-transfer-expert-knowledge",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"AI and AR-guided work instructions directly address these challenges. Here’s how:"}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Augmented reality (AR) SOPs:"})," Capture expert workflows as step-by-step visual instructions, overlaid directly on equipment or workspaces via smart glasses or tablets. Each step can include photos, videos, or annotations recorded by experts in real time."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"AI-powered content creation:"})," Use AI tools to transcribe, structure, and update SOPs based on expert input, automatically flagging gaps or inconsistencies."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Contextual guidance:"})," Teams see exactly what to do next, reducing ambiguity and reliance on memory or informal notes."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Continuous feedback loops:"})," Data from completed work instructions feeds back into AI models, helping refine SOPs and capture new insights from experienced staff."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"This approach turns expertise into living, digital assets—available to every technician, on demand."}),"
",i(r.h3,{id:"example-digitizing-a-critical-maintenance-procedure",children:["Example: digitizing a critical maintenance procedure",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#example-digitizing-a-critical-maintenance-procedure",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"A chemical plant faces the retirement of its lead compressor technician. Instead of relying on shadowing, the company equips the expert with AR glasses. As the technician performs a complex seal replacement, the system records audio, video, and annotated steps. AI tools transcribe and structure this into a digital SOP, which is reviewed and validated by the expert. The result: a detailed, visual guide available to every team member, reducing onboarding time and errors."}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"key-benefits-of-ar-and-aiguided-work-instructions-for-knowledge-capture",children:["Key benefits of AR and AI–guided work instructions for knowledge capture",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#key-benefits-of-ar-and-aiguided-work-instructions-for-knowledge-capture",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"AI and AR-guided work instructions provide clear, measurable advantages for industrial teams:"}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Faster onboarding:"})," New hires can follow expert-validated, step-by-step AR SOPs, reducing time to competency by 30–50% (source: ",n(r.a,{href:"https://www2.deloitte.com/us/en/pages/manufacturing/articles/digital-manufacturing-enterprise.html",children:"Deloitte, 2023 Digital Manufacturing Report"}),")."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Fewer errors and incidents:"})," Guided instructions and contextual prompts help teams avoid common mistakes, supporting higher safety and quality standards."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Up-to-date procedures:"})," AI tools make it easy to update SOPs as equipment or regulations change, ensuring compliance."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Retention of tacit knowledge:"})," Video, audio, and AR overlays capture the “tricks of the trade” that are lost in written documents."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Auditability:"})," Digital work instructions create a traceable record of who did what, when, and how—supporting regulatory and customer audits."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"practical-use-cases-across-industrial-environments",children:["Practical use cases across industrial environments",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#practical-use-cases-across-industrial-environments",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"AI and AR-guided work instructions are already delivering results in diverse sectors:"}),"
",i(r.h3,{id:"maintenance-and-asset-reliability",children:["Maintenance and asset reliability",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#maintenance-and-asset-reliability",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",n(r.li,{children:"Capture expert troubleshooting and repair routines for complex equipment"}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Standardize PM tasks with visual, step-by-step AR SOPs"}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Reduce downtime from avoidable errors as teams change"}),"
"]}),"
",i(r.h3,{id:"health-safety-and-environment-hse",children:["Health, safety, and environment (HSE)",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#health-safety-and-environment-hse",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",n(r.li,{children:"Digitize safety-critical procedures, such as lockout/tagout or confined space entry"}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Provide real-time guidance and documentation to meet compliance requirements"}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Support incident investigations with detailed, time-stamped work records"}),"
"]}),"
",i(r.h3,{id:"quality-assurance-and-audits",children:["Quality assurance and audits",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#quality-assurance-and-audits",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",n(r.li,{children:"Ensure all operators follow the same validated process for critical quality checks"}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Streamline preparation for ISO, FDA, or customer audits with digital SOPs and training records"}),"
"]}),"
",i(r.h3,{id:"training-and-workforce-development",children:["Training and workforce development",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#training-and-workforce-development",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",n(r.li,{children:"Create immersive onboarding experiences for new technicians"}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Enable “just-in-time” learning with AR overlays in the field"}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Reduce reliance on classroom-based or paper-based training"}),"
"]}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"addressing-common-challenges-hardware-change-management-and-content-creation",children:["Addressing common challenges: hardware, change management, and content creation",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#addressing-common-challenges-hardware-change-management-and-content-creation",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Implementing AI and AR-guided work instructions requires practical planning and governance. Common questions include:"}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"What hardware is required?"})," Most solutions work with standard tablets or smartphones, and many industrial AR platforms support smart glasses for hands-free use. It’s important to pilot hardware options in real environments."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"How is expert content captured?"})," Experts can record procedures as they work, using video, voice, and photos. AI tools help structure and tag this content, making it searchable and easy to update."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"What about change management?"})," Success depends on involving experienced staff early, demonstrating value, and providing support as teams adapt to new tools. Clear governance and KPIs are critical."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"How secure is the data?"})," Digital work instructions must be stored securely, with access controls and audit trails to protect intellectual property and support compliance."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(r.blockquote,{children:["
",i(r.p,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Note:"})," For a detailed look at AR onboarding, see ",n(r.a,{href:"/en/use-cases/ar-training-and-onboarding-for-industrial-teams",children:"AR onboarding for technicians"}),"."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"what-actarion-brings-to-the-table",children:["What ActARion brings to the table",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#what-actarion-brings-to-the-table",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"ActARion works with industrial companies to deploy AI and AR-guided work instruction platforms tailored to real operational needs. Our approach includes:"}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Industry-specific templates:"})," Pre-built AR SOPs and workflows for maintenance, safety, and quality scenarios"]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Expert-driven content capture:"})," Simple tools for recording and structuring expert knowledge, with AI-powered suggestions"]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Integration with existing systems:"})," Connect digital work instructions to your EHS, CMMS, or ERP platforms"]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Change management support:"})," Proven frameworks to engage teams, measure impact, and ensure adoption"]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Data security and compliance:"})," Robust controls to protect sensitive procedures and support audits"]}),"
"]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"We focus on practical, measurable outcomes—shorter onboarding, fewer errors, and preserved expertise as teams change."}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"explore-what-this-looks-like-in-your-organisation",children:["Explore what this looks like in your organisation",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#explore-what-this-looks-like-in-your-organisation",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"If you want to see how AI and AR-guided work instructions could help your team capture expert knowledge, reduce onboarding time, and maintain quality as experienced staff retire, schedule an exploratory discovery call. There’s no commitment—just a practical look at what’s possible in your setting."}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",n(r.li,{children:n(r.a,{href:"/en/about",children:"Learn more about ActARion’s approach"})}),"
",n(r.li,{children:n(r.a,{href:"/en/use-cases/ar-guided-assembly-for-error-free-production",children:"See how digital work instructions support compliance"})}),"
",i(r.li,{children:["For more on knowledge management, see ",n(r.a,{href:"https://hbr.org/2016/03/retaining-institutional-knowledge",children:"Harvard Business Review: Retaining Institutional Knowledge"}),"."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Let’s make sure your organisation’s expertise stays where it delivers value—on the shop floor, not walking out the door."})]})}return{default:function(e={}){const{wrapper:i}=e.components||{};return i?n(i,{...e,children:n(_createMdxContent,{...e})}):_createMdxContent(e)}};

title: Wie man den ROI von AR- und KI-gestützten Arbeitsanweisungen misst

image.alt: Wie man den ROI von AR- und KI-gestützten Arbeitsanweisungen misst

author: ActARion
body:
const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(r){const t={a:"a",blockquote:"blockquote",em:"em",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",h4:"h4",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...r.components};return i(e,{children:[i(t.h1,{id:"wie-man-den-roi-von-ar--und-ki-gestützten-arbeitsanweisungen-misst",children:["Wie man den ROI von AR- und KI-gestützten Arbeitsanweisungen misst",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#wie-man-den-roi-von-ar--und-ki-gestützten-arbeitsanweisungen-misst",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Das Verstehen der Kapitalrendite (ROI) für AR- und KI-gestützte Arbeitsanweisungen ist eine Top-Priorität für Operations Manager, HSE-Leiter, Wartungsleiter und L&D-Profis in industriellen Umgebungen. Mit Budgets unter Prüfung und Sicherheit, Produktivität und Workforce-Bereitschaft auf dem Spiel benötigen Entscheidungsträger klare Methoden, um Investitionen in digitale Arbeitsanweisungen zu rechtfertigen. Dieser Leitfaden bietet einen praktischen Rahmen zur Messung des ROI unter Verwendung von real-world Beispielen und bewährten Metriken."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"warum-die-roi-messung-für-digitale-arbeitsanweisungen-jetzt-wichtig-ist",children:["Warum die ROI-Messung für digitale Arbeitsanweisungen jetzt wichtig ist",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#warum-die-roi-messung-für-digitale-arbeitsanweisungen-jetzt-wichtig-ist",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Industrieunternehmen stehen unter unerbittlichem Druck, Verfügbarkeit zu verbessern, Compliance sicherzustellen, Vorfälle zu reduzieren und qualifizierte Techniker zu behalten. Traditionelle papierbasierte Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) und manuelle Schulungsmethoden sind oft langsam, fehleranfällig und schwer zu aktualisieren. Infolgedessen riskieren Organisationen:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Erhöhte Ausfallzeiten aufgrund von Fehlern und Nacharbeit"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Sicherheitsvorfälle, die aus übersprungenen Schritten oder unklaren Verfahren resultieren"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Längere Onboarding-Zeiten für neue Techniker"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Inkonsistente Qualität und Audit-Lücken"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Die Verschiebung zu AR- und KI-gestützten Arbeitsanweisungen beschleunigt sich, angetrieben durch die Notwendigkeit von Echtzeit-, standardisierten und leicht aktualisierbaren Verfahren. Dennoch zögern viele Leiter zu investieren, ohne klaren Nachweis finanzieller und operativer Renditen. ROI zu verstehen ist nicht länger optional—es ist wesentlich für die Rechtfertigung von Veränderung und die Gewährleistung nachhaltiger Wirkung."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"was-die-roi-messung-in-industriellen-umgebungen-herausfordernd-macht",children:["Was die ROI-Messung in industriellen Umgebungen herausfordernd macht",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#was-die-roi-messung-in-industriellen-umgebungen-herausfordernd-macht",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Im Gegensatz zu Software mit einfachen Lizenzmetriken haben AR- und KI-gestützte Arbeitsanweisungen Auswirkungen auf eine komplexe Mischung aus greifbaren und immateriellen Faktoren. Schlüsselherausforderungen umfassen:"}),"

title: Hoe ROI te meten van AR- en AI-geleide werkvoorschriften
description: Een praktische gids voor industriële besluitvormers over het meten van ROI van AR- en AI-geleide werkvoorschriften voor productiviteit, veiligheid en workforce-ontwikkeling.

const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(r){const a={a:"a",blockquote:"blockquote",em:"em",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",h4:"h4",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...r.components};return i(e,{children:[i(a.h1,{id:"hoe-roi-te-meten-van-ar--en-ai-geleide-werkvoorschriften",children:["Hoe ROI te meten van AR- en AI-geleide werkvoorschriften",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#hoe-roi-te-meten-van-ar--en-ai-geleide-werkvoorschriften",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Het begrijpen van de return on investment (ROI) voor AR- en AI-geleide werkvoorschriften is een topprioriteit voor operations managers, HSE-leiders, onderhoudsleiders en L&D-professionals in industriële omgevingen. Met budgetten onder toezicht en veiligheid, productiviteit en workforce readiness op het spel, hebben besluitvormers duidelijke methoden nodig om investeringen in digitale werkvoorschriften te rechtvaardigen. Deze gids biedt een praktisch framework voor het meten van ROI, met real-world voorbeelden en bewezen metrics."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"waarom-roi-meten-voor-digitale-werkvoorschriften-nu-belangrijk-is",children:["Waarom ROI meten voor digitale werkvoorschriften nu belangrijk is",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#waarom-roi-meten-voor-digitale-werkvoorschriften-nu-belangrijk-is",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Industriële bedrijven staan voor onophoudelijke druk om uptime te verbeteren, compliance te waarborgen, incidenten te verminderen en vaardige technici te behouden. Traditionele papiergebaseerde standard operating procedures (SOPs) en handmatige trainingsmethoden zijn vaak traag, foutgevoelig en moeilijk bij te werken. Als gevolg lopen organisaties risico op:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Verhoogde downtime door fouten en herwerk"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Veiligheidsincidenten voortkomend uit overgeslagen stappen of onduidelijke procedures"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Langere onboardingtijden voor nieuwe technici"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Inconsistente kwaliteit en audithiaten"}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"De verschuiving naar AR- en AI-geleide werkvoorschriften versnelt, gedreven door de behoefte aan real-time, gestandaardiseerde en gemakkelijk bij te werken procedures. body:
const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(r){const a={a:"a",blockquote:"blockquote",em:"em",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",h4:"h4",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...r.components};return i(e,{children:[i(a.h1,{id:"how-to-measure-the-roi-of-ar-and-ai-guided-work-instructions",children:["How to measure the ROI of AR and AI guided work instructions",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-to-measure-the-roi-of-ar-and-ai-guided-work-instructions",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Understanding the return on investment (ROI) for AR and AI guided work instructions is a top priority for operations managers, HSE leaders, maintenance heads, and L&D professionals in industrial environments. With budgets under scrutiny and safety, productivity, and workforce readiness at stake, decision makers need clear methods to justify investments in digital work instructions. This guide provides a practical framework for measuring ROI, using real-world examples and proven metrics."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"why-measuring-roi-for-digital-work-instructions-matters-now",children:["Why measuring ROI for digital work instructions matters now",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#why-measuring-roi-for-digital-work-instructions-matters-now",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Industrial companies face relentless pressure to improve uptime, ensure compliance, reduce incidents, and retain skilled technicians. Traditional paper-based standard operating procedures (SOPs) and manual training methods are often slow, error-prone, and hard to update. As a result, organizations risk:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Increased downtime due to mistakes and rework"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Safety incidents stemming from skipped steps or unclear procedures"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Longer onboarding times for new technicians"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Inconsistent quality and audit gaps"}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"The move to AR and AI–guided work instructions is accelerating, driven by the need for real-time, standardized, and easily updated procedures. Yet, many leaders hesitate to invest without clear evidence of financial and operational returns. Understanding ROI is no longer optional—it is essential for justifying change and ensuring sustained impact."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"what-makes-roi-measurement-challenging-in-industrial-settings",children:["What makes ROI measurement challenging in industrial settings",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#what-makes-roi-measurement-challenging-in-industrial-settings",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Unlike software with simple license metrics, AR and AI guided work instructions impact a complex mix of tangible and intangible factors. Key challenges include:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Defining baseline performance:"})," Many teams lack detailed historical data on error rates, training times, or rework."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Quantifying “soft” benefits:"})," Improvements in knowledge retention, safety culture, or employee confidence can be hard to express in financial terms."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Attribution:"})," When multiple improvement projects run in parallel, isolating the impact of digital work instructions is complex."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Hardware and integration costs:"})," Upfront investments in AR devices and system integration must be included, not just software costs."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Despite these challenges, a growing body of case studies and proven frameworks make ROI measurement both feasible and credible."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"the-core-roi-framework-for-ar-and-ai-guided-work-instructions",children:["The core ROI framework for AR and AI guided work instructions",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#the-core-roi-framework-for-ar-and-ai-guided-work-instructions",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"A robust ROI calculation for digital work instructions in industrial settings should cover both direct and indirect benefits. The most common approach includes:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["

title: Remote-Experten-Support mit AR: Ausfallzeiten lösen, ohne Spezialisten einzufliegen
description: Entdecken Sie, wie Remote-Experten-Support mit AR industrielle Teams befähigt, Ausfallzeiten schneller zu lösen, Qualität aufrechtzuerhalten und Kosten zu reduzieren, ohne Spezialisten einzufliegen.

image.alt: Remote-Experten-Support mit AR: Ausfallzeiten lösen, ohne Spezialisten einzufliegen

author: ActARion
body:
const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(r){const t={a:"a",blockquote:"blockquote",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...r.components};return i(e,{children:[i(t.h1,{id:"remote-experten-support-mit-ar-ausfallzeiten-lösen-ohne-spezialisten-einzufliegen",children:["Remote-Experten-Support mit AR: Ausfallzeiten lösen, ohne Spezialisten einzufliegen",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#remote-experten-support-mit-ar-ausfallzeiten-lösen-ohne-spezialisten-einzufliegen",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Ungeplante Ausfallzeiten sind eine kritische Herausforderung für industrielle Operationen. Wenn Systeme ausfallen oder komplexe Wartung erforderlich ist, bedeutet der schnellste Weg zur Lösung oft, einen externen Spezialisten einzubringen—zu erheblichen Kosten, Verzögerung und Risiko für Produktivität. Remote-Experten-Support mit AR (Augmented Reality) ändert diese Gleichung. Durch Ermöglichen von Echtzeit-, On-Site-Anleitung von Experten überall auf der Welt helfen KI- und AR-gestützte Arbeitsanweisungen Ihren Teams, Ausfallzeiten schneller zu lösen, Qualität und Sicherheit aufrechtzuerhalten und die Notwendigkeit zu vermeiden, Spezialisten einzufliegen."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"ausfallzeiten-und-spezialistenabhängigkeit-warum-veränderung-dringend-ist",children:["Ausfallzeiten und Spezialistenabhängigkeit: warum Veränderung dringend ist",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#ausfallzeiten-und-spezialistenabhängigkeit-warum-veränderung-dringend-ist",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Industrielle Standorte—ob Produktionsanlagen, Energieeinrichtungen oder Logistik-Hubs—verlassen sich auf reibungslosen, ununterbrochenen Betrieb komplexer Ausrüstung. Wenn etwas schiefgeht, sind die Konsequenzen unmittelbar:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Produktionslinien stoppen, verursachen Verlust von Output und Umsatz."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Sicherheitsrisiken steigen, besonders wenn unbekannte Teams dringende Reparaturen versuchen."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Compliance und Qualität können beeinträchtigt werden, wenn unqualifizierte Interventionen vorgenommen werden."}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Traditionell war die Lösung, einen Lieferanten oder technischen Spezialisten anzurufen. Laut einem ARC Advisory Group-Bericht von 2023 kosten ungeplante Ausfallzeiten Hersteller geschätzte 50 Milliarden Dollar pro Jahr weltweit, wobei bis zu 42% der Vorfälle externe Intervention erfordern. Reiseverzögerungen, Visa-Prozesse und Spezialisten-Verfügbarkeit können Ausfallzeiten leicht von Stunden auf Tage ausdehnen."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Dieser Ansatz ist zunehmend unhaltbar:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Steigende Reisekosten und Lieferkettenstörungen machen das Einfliegen von Experten teurer und weniger zuverlässig."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Qualifikationsengpässe bedeuten, dass weniger Spezialisten verfügbar sind, besonders für Legacy- oder maßgeschneiderte Ausrüstung."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Umwelt- und ESG-Ziele drängen Unternehmen, unnötige Reisen zu minimieren."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Teams müssen aufrüsten und selbstständiger werden, um Verfügbarkeit und Sicherheit aufrechtzuerhalten."}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"die-lücke-warum-on-site-teams-mit-komplexen-problemen-kämpfen",children:["Die Lücke: warum On-Site-Teams mit komplexen Problemen kämpfen",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#die-lücke-warum-on-site-teams-mit-komplexen-problemen-kämpfen",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Selbst mit starken internen Wartungs- und Operationsteams verhindern mehrere Barrieren schnelle Lösung komplexer Probleme:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"OEM-Handbücher und SOPs sind oft statisch, generisch und schwer unter Druck zu befolgen."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Wissenstransfer ist inkonsistent, besonders bei Personalfluktuation und Pensionierungen."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Remote-Support-Anrufe über Telefon oder Video fehlt der Kontext und Klarheit, die für präzise Fehlerbehebung benötigt wird."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Sprachbarrieren und Misskommunikation führen zu Fehlern und Nacharbeit."}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Für Entscheidungsträger ist das Ergebnis ein schwieriger Kompromiss: akzeptieren Sie kostspielige Ausfallzeiten oder akzeptieren Sie die Risiken unvollständiger oder falscher Reparaturen."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"wie-remote-experten-support-mit-ar-funktioniert",children:["Wie Remote-Experten-Support mit AR funktioniert",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#wie-remote-experten-support-mit-ar-funktioniert",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Remote-Experten-Support mit AR überbrückt diese Lücken, indem Live-, Echtzeit-Kommunikation mit digitalen Overlays, schrittweisen AR-SOPs und KI-gestützter Anleitung kombiniert wird. So funktioniert es in der Praxis:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"On-Site-Techniker verwenden AR-fähige Geräte (Smart Glasses, Tablets oder Telefone), um sich mit Remote-Experten zu verbinden."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Der Experte sieht genau, was der Techniker sieht, in Echtzeit, über einen sicheren Video-Feed."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Mit AR kann der Experte das Sichtfeld des Technikers annotieren—Komponenten hervorheben, Pfeile zeichnen oder Anweisungen direkt über die Ausrüstung legen."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"KI- und AR-gestützte Arbeitsanweisungen bieten relevante SOPs, Checklisten und Fehlerbehebungs-Schritte, angepasst für das spezifische Asset und Szenario."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Dokumentation und Sitzungsaufzeichnung gewährleisten Compliance und Wissenserfassung für zukünftige Referenz."}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Dieses Setup transformiert Remote-Support von einem passiven Telefonanruf zu einer interaktiven, kontextreichen Zusammenarbeit."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"schlüsselfunktionen-von-remote-experten-support-mit-ar",children:["Schlüsselfunktionen von Remote-Experten-Support mit AR",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#schlüsselfunktionen-von-remote-experten-support-mit-ar",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Organisationen, die AR-basierten Remote-Support übernehmen, realisieren messbare Verbesserungen in mehreren Bereichen:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Schnellere Lösung von Ausfallzeiten:"})," Teams können sofort mit Fehlerbehebung beginnen, ohne auf Reisen oder Planung zu warten."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Verbesserte Sicherheit und Compliance:"})," Schrittweise AR-SOPs reduzieren Fehlerrisiko und gewährleisten Einhaltung von Verfahren."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Reduzierte Kosten:"})," Eliminierung von Reisen und Reduzierung wiederholter Standortbesuche spart direkte und indirekte Kosten."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Belegschaftsaufrüstung:"})," On-Site-Teams gewinnen Vertrauen und Expertise, indem sie Probleme unter Expertenanleitung durcharbeiten."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Bessere Dokumentation:"})," Jede Sitzung kann für Audit, Schulung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung erfasst werden."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Eine Capgemini-Studie von 2022 ergab, dass Unternehmen, die AR-Remote-Assistance verwenden, Maschinenausfallzeiten um 30–50% reduzierten, mit einer ähnlichen Reduzierung reisebedingter Kosten."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"praktische-anwendungsfälle-in-industriellen-umgebungen",children:["Praktische Anwendungsfälle in industriellen Umgebungen",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#praktische-anwendungsfälle-in-industriellen-umgebungen",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Remote-Experten-Support mit AR liefert bereits Ergebnisse in Sektoren wie Produktion, Energie, Versorgungsunternehmen und Logistik. Hier sind einige konkrete Szenarien:"}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"komplexe-ausrüstungs-fehlerbehebung",children:["Komplexe Ausrüstungs-Fehlerbehebung",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#komplexe-ausrüstungs-fehlerbehebung",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"

title: Remote expert support met AR: downtime oplossen zonder specialisten in te vliegen
description: Ontdek hoe remote expert support met AR industriële teams in staat stelt downtime sneller op te lossen, kwaliteit te handhaven en kosten te verminderen zonder specialisten in te vliegen.

image.alt: Remote expert support met AR: downtime oplossen zonder specialisten in te vliegen

author: ActARion
body:
const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(r){const t={a:"a",blockquote:"blockquote",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...r.components};return i(e,{children:[i(t.h1,{id:"remote-expert-support-met-ar-downtime-oplossen-zonder-specialisten-in-te-vliegen",children:["Remote expert support met AR: downtime oplossen zonder specialisten in te vliegen",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#remote-expert-support-met-ar-downtime-oplossen-zonder-specialisten-in-te-vliegen",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Ongeplande downtime is een kritieke uitdaging voor industriële operaties. Wanneer systemen falen of complex onderhoud vereist is, betekent de snelste weg naar oplossing vaak het binnenhalen van een externe specialist—tegen aanzienlijke kosten, vertraging en risico voor productiviteit. Remote expert support met AR (augmented reality) verandert die vergelijking. Door real-time, on-site begeleiding van experts overal ter wereld mogelijk te maken, helpen AI- en AR-geleide werkvoorschriften uw teams downtime sneller op te lossen, kwaliteit en veiligheid te handhaven en de behoefte om specialisten in te vliegen te vermijden."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"downtime-en-specialistafhankelijkheid-waarom-verandering-urgent-is",children:["Downtime en specialistafhankelijkheid: waarom verandering urgent is",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#downtime-en-specialistafhankelijkheid-waarom-verandering-urgent-is",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Industriële sites—of het nu productiefabrieken, energie-installaties of logistieke hubs zijn—vertrouwen op soepele, ononderbroken operatie van complexe apparatuur. Wanneer iets misgaat, zijn de gevolgen onmiddellijk:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Productielijnen stoppen, wat verlies van output en omzet veroorzaakt."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Veiligheidsrisico's nemen toe, vooral wanneer onbekende teams urgente reparaties proberen."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Compliance en kwaliteit kunnen worden aangetast als ongekwalificeerde interventies worden gemaakt."}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Traditioneel is de oplossing geweest om een leverancier of technische specialist in te schakelen. Volgens een rapport uit 2023 van ARC Advisory Group kosten ongeplande downtime fabrikanten naar schatting $50 miljard per jaar wereldwijd, waarbij tot 42% van de incidenten externe interventie vereist. Reisvertragingen, visaprocessen en specialistbeschikbaarheid kunnen downtime gemakkelijk van uren naar dagen rekken."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Deze aanpak is steeds onhoudbaarder:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Stijgende reiskosten en supply chain-verstoringen maken het invliegen van experts duurder en minder betrouwbaar."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Vaardigheidstekorten betekenen dat minder specialisten beschikbaar zijn, vooral voor legacy of op maat gemaakte apparatuur."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Milieu- en ESG-doelen duwen bedrijven om onnodige reizen te minimaliseren."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Teams moeten upskillen en zelfredzamer worden om uptime en veiligheid te handhaven."}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"de-kloof-waarom-on-site-teams-worstelen-met-complexe-problemen",children:["De kloof: waarom on-site teams worstelen met complexe problemen",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#de-kloof-waarom-on-site-teams-worstelen-met-complexe-problemen",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Zelfs met sterke interne onderhouds- en operationsteams voorkomen verschillende barrières snelle oplossing van complexe problemen:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"OEM-handleidingen en SOPs zijn vaak statisch, generiek en moeilijk te volgen onder druk."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Kennisoverdracht is inconsistent, vooral met personeelsverloop en pensioneringen."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Remote support-oproepen via telefoon of video missen de context en duidelijkheid nodig voor precieze troubleshooting."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Taalbarrières en miscommunicatie leiden tot fouten en herwerk."}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Voor besluitvormers is het resultaat een moeilijke afweging: accepteer kostbare downtime, of accepteer de risico's van incomplete of incorrecte reparaties."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"hoe-remote-expert-support-met-ar-werkt",children:["Hoe remote expert support met AR werkt",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#hoe-remote-expert-support-met-ar-werkt",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Remote expert support met AR overbrugt deze hiaten door live, real-time communicatie te combineren met digitale overlays, stap-voor-stap AR SOPs en AI-gedreven begeleiding. Zo werkt het in de praktijk:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["

",n(t.li,{children:"De expert ziet precies wat de technicus ziet, in real-time, via een beveiligde videofeed."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Met AR kan de expert het gezichtsveld van de technicus annoteren—componenten markeren, pijlen tekenen of instructies direct over de apparatuur leggen."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"AI- en AR-geleide werkvoorschriften bieden relevante SOPs, checklists en troubleshooting-stappen, aangepast voor het specifieke asset en scenario."}),"

",n(t.p,{children:"Organisaties die AR-gebaseerde remote support adopteren realiseren meetbare verbeteringen in verschillende gebieden:"}),"

",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Verbeterde veiligheid en compliance:"})," Stap-voor-stap AR SOPs verminderen foutrisico en waarborgen naleving van procedures."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Verminderde kosten:"})," Het elimineren van reizen en het verminderen van herhaalde sitebezoeken bespaart directe en indirecte kosten."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Workforce upskilling:"})," On-site teams krijgen vertrouwen en expertise door problemen door te werken onder expertbegeleiding."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Betere documentatie:"})," Elke sessie kan worden vastgelegd voor audit, training en continue verbetering."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Een Capgemini-studie uit 2022 vond dat bedrijven die AR remote assistance gebruiken machinedowntime met 30–50% reduceerden, met een vergelijkbare reductie in reisgerelateerde kosten."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"praktische-use-cases-in-industriële-omgevingen",children:["Praktische use cases in industriële omgevingen",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#praktische-use-cases-in-industriële-omgevingen",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Remote expert support met AR levert al resultaten in sectoren zoals productie, energie, nutsbedrijven en logistiek. Hier zijn enkele concrete scenario's:"}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"complexe-apparatuur-troubleshooting",children:["Complexe apparatuur troubleshooting",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#complexe-apparatuur-troubleshooting",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Een verpakkingslijn in een voedingsverwerkingsfabriek valt uit door een sensorfout. Het onderhoudsteam verbindt met een remote OEM-specialist met AR slimme brillen. De expert begeleidt het team door diagnostiek, markeert bedrading en sensorlocaties in het gezichtsveld van de technicus en bevestigt de fix—alles zonder hun kantoor te verlaten."}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"inbedrijfstelling-en-kalibratie",children:["Inbedrijfstelling en kalibratie",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#inbedrijfstelling-en-kalibratie",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Een nieuw geautomatiseerd inspectiesysteem moet worden gekalibreerd om regelgevingsstandaarden te halen. In plaats van te wachten op een leveranciersvertegenwoordiger, gebruikt de kwaliteitsengineer van de fabriek AR-enabled instructies en verbindt met een remote kalibratie-expert. Live AR-overlays verminderen ambiguïteit, waarborgen nauwkeurigheid en minimaliseren het risico op non-compliance."}),"

",n(t.p,{children:"Een chemische fabriek ervaart een alarm op een kritiek ventiel. Het incident wordt veilig opgelost, met volledige documentatie voor follow-up."}),"

",n(t.p,{children:"Nieuwe technici sluiten zich aan bij een windturbine-onderhoudsteam met beperkte hands-on ervaring. Door AI- en AR-geleide werkvoorschriften te combineren met remote mentoring, versnelt het team onboarding en waarborgt dat elke stap correct wordt uitgevoerd—zelfs tijdens hun eerste solo-interventie."}),"

",n(t.p,{children:"Om de voordelen van AR remote support te realiseren, moeten organisaties verschillende praktische overwegingen adresseren:"}),"

",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Apparaatcompatibiliteit:"})," Zorg ervoor dat AR-oplossingen werken met bestaande apparaten (slimme brillen, tablets, robuuste smartphones) en kunnen opereren in uitdagende omgevingen (handschoenen, PBM, variabele verlichting)."]}),"

",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Change management:"})," Teams hebben training, ondersteuning en duidelijke governance nodig om nieuwe workflows te adopteren en ROI te maximaliseren."]}),"

",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Governance en compliance:"})," We helpen u toegang, recordkeeping en audittrails beheren voor elke support-sessie."]}),"

title: Remote expert support with AR: resolving downtime without flying in specialists
description: Discover how remote expert support with AR enables industrial teams to resolve downtime faster, maintain quality, and reduce costs without flying in specialists.

image.alt: Remote expert support with AR: resolving downtime without flying in specialists

author: ActARion
body:
const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(t){const r={a:"a",blockquote:"blockquote",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...t.components};return i(e,{children:[i(r.h1,{id:"remote-expert-support-with-ar-resolving-downtime-without-flying-in-specialists",children:["Remote expert support with AR: resolving downtime without flying in specialists",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#remote-expert-support-with-ar-resolving-downtime-without-flying-in-specialists",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Unplanned downtime is a critical challenge for industrial operations. When systems fail or complex maintenance is required, the fastest path to resolution often means bringing in an external specialist—at significant cost, delay, and risk to productivity. Remote expert support with AR (augmented reality) is changing that equation. By enabling real-time, on-site guidance from experts anywhere in the world, AI and AR–guided work instructions help your teams resolve downtime faster, maintain quality and safety, and avoid the need to fly in specialists."}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"downtime-and-specialist-dependence-why-change-is-urgent",children:["Downtime and specialist dependence: why change is urgent",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#downtime-and-specialist-dependence-why-change-is-urgent",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Industrial sites—whether manufacturing plants, energy facilities, or logistics hubs—rely on the smooth, uninterrupted operation of complex equipment. When something goes wrong, the consequences are immediate:"}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",n(r.li,{children:"Production lines stop, causing loss of output and revenue."}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Safety risks increase, especially when unfamiliar teams attempt urgent repairs."}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Compliance and quality can be compromised if unqualified interventions are made."}),"
"]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Traditionally, the solution has been to call in a vendor or technical specialist. According to a 2023 ARC Advisory Group report, unplanned downtime costs manufacturers an estimated $50 billion per year globally, with up to 42% of incidents requiring external intervention. Travel delays, visa processes, and specialist availability can easily stretch downtime from hours to days."}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"This approach is increasingly unsustainable:"}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",n(r.li,{children:"Rising travel costs and supply chain disruptions make flying in experts more expensive and less reliable."}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Skills shortages mean fewer specialists are available, especially for legacy or bespoke equipment."}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Environmental and ESG goals push companies to minimize unnecessary travel."}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Teams need to upskill and become more self-reliant to maintain uptime and safety."}),"
"]}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"the-gap-why-on-site-teams-struggle-with-complex-issues",children:["The gap: why on-site teams struggle with complex issues",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#the-gap-why-on-site-teams-struggle-with-complex-issues",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Even with strong in-house maintenance and operations teams, several barriers prevent rapid resolution of complex problems:"}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",n(r.li,{children:"OEM manuals and SOPs are often static, generic, and hard to follow under pressure."}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Knowledge transfer is inconsistent, especially with staff turnover and retirements."}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Remote support calls via phone or video lack the context and clarity needed for precise troubleshooting."}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Language barriers and miscommunication lead to errors and rework."}),"
"]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"For decision makers, the result is a difficult trade-off: accept costly downtime, or accept the risks of incomplete or incorrect repairs."}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"how-remote-expert-support-with-ar-works",children:["How remote expert support with AR works",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-remote-expert-support-with-ar-works",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Remote expert support with AR bridges these gaps by combining live, real-time communication with digital overlays, step-by-step AR SOPs, and AI-powered guidance. Here’s how it works in practice:"}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",n(r.li,{children:"On-site technicians use AR-enabled devices (smart glasses, tablets, or phones) to connect with remote experts."}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"The expert sees exactly what the technician sees, in real time, through a secure video feed."}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Using AR, the expert can annotate the technician’s field of view—highlighting components, drawing arrows, or overlaying instructions directly onto the equipment."}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"AI and AR–guided work instructions provide relevant SOPs, checklists, and troubleshooting steps, customized for the specific asset and scenario."}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Documentation and session recording ensure compliance and knowledge capture for future reference."}),"
"]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"This setup transforms remote support from a passive phone call to an interactive, context-rich collaboration."}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"key-benefits-of-remote-expert-support-with-ar",children:["Key benefits of remote expert support with AR",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#key-benefits-of-remote-expert-support-with-ar",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Organizations adopting AR-based remote support realize measurable improvements in several areas:"}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Faster resolution of downtime:"})," Teams can begin troubleshooting immediately, without waiting for travel or scheduling."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Improved safety and compliance:"})," Step-by-step AR SOPs reduce risk of error and ensure adherence to procedures."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Reduced costs:"})," Eliminating travel and reducing repeat site visits saves direct and indirect costs."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Workforce upskilling:"})," On-site teams gain confidence and expertise by working through issues under expert guidance."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Better documentation:"})," Every session can be captured for audit, training, and continuous improvement."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"A 2022 Capgemini study found that companies using AR remote assistance reduced machine downtime by 30–50%, with a similar reduction in travel-related costs."}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"practical-use-cases-in-industrial-environments",children:["Practical use cases in industrial environments",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#practical-use-cases-in-industrial-environments",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Remote expert support with AR is already delivering results in sectors such as manufacturing, energy, utilities, and logistics. Here are some concrete scenarios:"}),"
",i(r.h3,{id:"complex-equipment-troubleshooting",children:["Complex equipment troubleshooting",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#complex-equipment-troubleshooting",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"A packaging line in a food processing plant goes down due to a sensor fault. The maintenance team connects with a remote OEM specialist using AR smart glasses. The expert guides the team through diagnostics, highlights wiring and sensor locations in the technician’s field of view, and confirms the fix—all without leaving their office."}),"
",i(r.h3,{id:"commissioning-and-calibration",children:["Commissioning and calibration",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#commissioning-and-calibration",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"A new automated inspection system must be calibrated to meet regulatory standards. Instead of waiting for a vendor representative, the plant’s quality engineer uses AR-enabled instructions and connects with a remote calibration expert. Live AR overlays reduce ambiguity, ensure accuracy, and minimize the risk of non-compliance."}),"
",i(r.h3,{id:"emergency-response-and-safety-incidents",children:["Emergency response and safety incidents",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#emergency-response-and-safety-incidents",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"A chemical plant experiences an alarm on a critical valve. The HSE manager initiates a remote support session with a process safety expert, who walks the on-site team through isolation procedures using AR overlays and digital checklists. The incident is resolved safely, with full documentation for follow-up."}),"
",i(r.h3,{id:"training-and-onboarding",children:["Training and onboarding",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#training-and-onboarding",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"New technicians join a wind farm maintenance team with limited hands-on experience. By pairing AI and AR–guided work instructions with remote mentoring, the team accelerates onboarding and ensures that every step is performed correctly—even during their first solo intervention."}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"whats-needed-for-effective-remote-expert-support",children:["What’s needed for effective remote expert support",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#whats-needed-for-effective-remote-expert-support",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"To realize the benefits of AR remote support, organizations should address several practical considerations:"}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Device compatibility:"})," Ensure AR solutions work with existing devices (smart glasses, tablets, rugged smartphones) and can operate in challenging environments (gloves, PPE, variable lighting)."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Network reliability:"})," Industrial sites must provide secure, stable connectivity—ideally with offline fallback for critical instructions."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Content readiness:"})," Digital SOPs and AI–guided instructions must be accurate, up-to-date, and tailored to assets and processes."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Data security:"})," All remote sessions and data transfers should comply with company and regulatory standards for privacy and cybersecurity."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Change management:"})," Teams need training, support, and clear governance to adopt new workflows and maximize ROI."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(r.blockquote,{children:["
",i(r.p,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Note:"})," While AR remote support reduces the need for specialist travel, it does not eliminate the need for on-site expertise in all cases. Some interventions (e.g., high-voltage work, hazardous materials) may still require certified specialists on site."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"how-actarion-enables-remote-expert-support-with-ar",children:["How ActARion enables remote expert support with AR",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-actarion-enables-remote-expert-support-with-ar",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"ActARion partners with industrial organizations to deploy remote expert support that is robust, scalable, and tailored to operational realities. Our approach combines:"}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"AI and AR–guided work instructions:"})," We digitize your SOPs and asset-specific procedures for real-time use in the field."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Seamless remote session management:"})," Secure video, annotation, and documentation tools integrate with your existing systems."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Governance and compliance:"})," We help you manage access, recordkeeping, and audit trails for every support session."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Change enablement:"})," Our experts support your teams through onboarding, training, and continuous improvement."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"This means your teams are empowered to resolve downtime and complex issues, safely and efficiently—without waiting for external specialists to arrive on site."}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"results-measurable-impact-on-productivity-and-cost",children:["Results: measurable impact on productivity and cost",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#results-measurable-impact-on-productivity-and-cost",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Organizations using ActARion’s remote expert support with AR report:"}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",n(r.li,{children:"30–60% reduction in average downtime per incident"}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"40% drop in travel-related support costs"}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Improved first-time fix rates and reduced repeat visits"}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Higher technician engagement and skills retention"}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Enhanced compliance and traceability for critical interventions"}),"
"]}),"
",i(r.p,{children:["These outcomes are supported by real-world deployments across manufacturing, energy, and logistics sectors. For more details, see our ",n(r.a,{href:"/en/use-cases",children:"case studies and use cases"}),"."]}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"explore-remote-expert-support-for-your-organisation",children:["Explore remote expert support for your organisation",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#explore-remote-expert-support-for-your-organisation",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Remote expert support with AR enables your teams to resolve downtime quickly, maintain quality, and reduce costs—without flying in specialists. To explore how this looks for your specific assets, sites, and teams, schedule a discovery call with ActARion. This is an exploratory conversation, not a commitment."}),"
",i(r.p,{children:["Learn more about ",n(r.a,{href:"/en/use-cases",children:"AI and AR–guided work instructions"}),", or see how ",n(r.a,{href:"/en/use-cases/ar-training-and-onboarding-for-industrial-teams",children:"AR onboarding for technicians"})," accelerates skills transfer. For industry trends and best practices, see the ",n(r.a,{href:"https://www.weforum.org/agenda/2022/11/augmented-reality-manufacturing-industry/",children:"World Economic Forum on AR in industry"}),"."]})]})}return{default:function(e={}){const{wrapper:i}=e.components||{};return i?n(i,{...e,children:n(_createMdxContent,{...e})}):_createMdxContent(e)}};

const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:r}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(i){const t={a:"a",blockquote:"blockquote",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...i.components};return r(e,{children:[r(t.h1,{id:"ar-arbeitsanweisungen-verwenden-um-seltene-oder-hochriskante-verfahren-zu-standardisieren",children:["AR-Arbeitsanweisungen verwenden, um seltene oder hochriskante Verfahren zu standardisieren",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#ar-arbeitsanweisungen-verwenden-um-seltene-oder-hochriskante-verfahren-zu-standardisieren",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Industrielle Teams stehen regelmäßig vor Verfahren, die, obwohl selten, erhebliches Risiko tragen. Komplexe Umstellungen, Notabschaltungen, enge Räume Zugang und kritische Wartungsaufgaben erfordern absolute Präzision. Dennoch, weil diese Verfahren selten durchgeführt werden, können selbst erfahrene Techniker und Operatoren Schwierigkeiten haben, sich an genaue Schritte zu erinnern, was das Risiko von Fehlern, Vorfällen und Ausfallzeiten erhöht."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Augmented Reality (AR) Arbeitsanweisungen bieten einen praktischen, bewährten Weg, diese seltenen oder hochriskanten Verfahren zu standardisieren—macht Arbeit sicherer, konsistenter und leichter zu auditieren."}),"
",r(t.h2,{id:"warum-seltene-und-hochriskante-verfahren-eine-herausforderung-bleiben",children:["Warum seltene und hochriskante Verfahren eine Herausforderung bleiben",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#warum-seltene-und-hochriskante-verfahren-eine-herausforderung-bleiben",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Die meisten industriellen Standorte haben robuste Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) für tägliche Aufgaben. Aber seltene oder hochriskante Verfahren schaffen einzigartige Herausforderungen:"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Techniker haben möglicherweise keine wiederholte Exposition zu den Schritten, also verblasst das Gedächtnis."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Papierbasierte SOPs können übersehen, falsch interpretiert oder veraltet sein."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Verbale Übergaben verlieren Details, besonders über Schichten oder Teams."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Hochriskante Aufgaben erfordern oft schnelle, korrekte Aktion unter Druck."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Auditoren und Sicherheitsleiter benötigen klaren Nachweis von Compliance und Schulung."}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Zum Beispiel führt eine Chemieanlage möglicherweise nur einmal im Jahr eine vollständige Behälterdekontamination durch. Ein Wasserversorger isoliert möglicherweise nur große Pipelines während Notreparaturen. In diesen Fällen kann ein einzelner Fehler zu Verletzungen, Umweltvorfällen oder kostspieligen Ausfallzeiten führen."}),"
",r(t.p,{children:["Forschung der Institution of Chemical Engineers (IChemE) hebt hervor, dass seltene Verfahren unverhältnismäßig in Vorfallberichten vertreten sind, größtenteils aufgrund von Gedächtnislücken, unklaren Anweisungen oder unvollständigen Übergaben (",n(t.a,{href:"https://www.icheme.org/",children:"IChemE, 2020"}),")."]}),"
",r(t.h2,{id:"warum-jetzt-regulatorische-und-workforce-trends-erhöhen-den-bedarf-an-standardisierung",children:["Warum jetzt: regulatorische und Workforce-Trends erhöhen den Bedarf an Standardisierung",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#warum-jetzt-regulatorische-und-workforce-trends-erhöhen-den-bedarf-an-standardisierung",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Mehrere Trends konvergieren, um Standardisierung seltener und hochriskanter Verfahren zu einer Top-Priorität zu machen:"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Strengere regulatorische Anforderungen"})," für evidenzbasierte Schulung und Verfahrens-Compliance."]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Alternde Belegschaft"})," und erhöhte Fluktuation, führt zu Verlust von institutionellem Wissen."]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Komplexere Ausrüstung"})," und vernetzte Systeme, erhöht die Einsätze für Fehler."]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Digitale Transformationsmandate"}),", erfordern rückverfolgbare, auditierbare Prozesse."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Für Operations Manager, HSE-Leiter und Trainingsprofis reicht es nicht mehr aus, sich auf statische Dokumente oder informelles Coaching zu verlassen. Digitale Lösungen, die Anleitung am Arbeitspunkt liefern—und Ausführungsnachweis erfassen—sind jetzt wesentlich für operative Exzellenz."}),"
",r(t.h2,{id:"wie-ar-arbeitsanweisungen-sicherere-konsistentere-ausführung-unterstützen",children:["Wie AR-Arbeitsanweisungen sicherere, konsistentere Ausführung unterstützen",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#wie-ar-arbeitsanweisungen-sicherere-konsistentere-ausführung-unterstützen",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"

",r(t.ul,{children:["
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Visuelle Overlays:"})," Diagramme, Animationen und Marker, die genau zeigen, wo zu handeln ist."]}),"

",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Eingebettete Referenzmaterialien:"})," Sicherheitsdatenblätter, Ausrüstungshandbücher oder Videoclips."]}),"

"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Dieser Ansatz adressiert die Kernrisiken seltener oder hochriskanter Verfahren:"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Reduziert Abhängigkeit von Gedächtnis oder Papier."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Gewährleistet, dass kritische Schritte nicht übersprungen oder außerhalb der Reihenfolge ausgeführt werden."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Unterstützt weniger erfahrene Teammitglieder mit Just-in-Time-Wissen."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Bietet Echtzeit-Unterstützung für Fehlerbehebung oder Eskalation."}),"
"]}),"
",r(t.blockquote,{children:["
",r(t.p,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Hinweis:"})," Eine Studie von 2022 des Fraunhofer-Instituts ergab, dass AR-gestützte Verfahren Fehlerraten um 40% reduzierten und Verfahrens-Compliance um über 30% in pharmazeutischer und chemischer Produktion verbesserten."]}),"
"]}),"
",r(t.h2,{id:"anwendungsfälle-wo-ar-sops-die-größte-wirkung-haben",children:["Anwendungsfälle: wo AR-SOPs die größte Wirkung haben",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#anwendungsfälle-wo-ar-sops-die-größte-wirkung-haben",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"AR-Arbeitsanweisungen sind besonders wertvoll für Verfahren, bei denen die Einsätze hoch sind und Wiederholung niedrig. Häufige industrielle Anwendungsfälle umfassen:"}),"
",r(t.h3,{id:"notabschaltungen-und-lockouttagout-loto",children:["Notabschaltungen und Lockout/Tagout (LOTO)",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#notabschaltungen-und-lockouttagout-loto",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Wenn eine Linie oder Einrichtung sicher abgeschaltet werden muss, zählt jeder Schritt. AR-SOPs führen Techniker durch die korrekte Sequenz, bestätigen jeden Isolationspunkt und protokollieren Ausführungsnachweis—minimiert das Risiko versehentlicher Energisierung."}),"
",r(t.h3,{id:"enge-räume-zugang",children:["Enge Räume Zugang",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#enge-räume-zugang",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"AR-gestützte Checklisten gewährleisten, dass alle Pre-Zugang-Sicherheitsprüfungen, Atmosphärentests und Genehmigungsanforderungen abgeschlossen und dokumentiert sind, bevor jemand ein Gefäß oder einen Tank betritt. Visuelle Overlays helfen, Zugangspunkte und Gefahren zu identifizieren."}),"
",r(t.h3,{id:"kritische-wartung-und-kalibrierungen",children:["Kritische Wartung und Kalibrierungen",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#kritische-wartung-und-kalibrierungen",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"

",n(t.p,{children:"Industrieunternehmen, die AR-Arbeitsanweisungen für seltene oder hochriskante Verfahren verwenden, berichten von konkreten Vorteilen:"}),"

title: Using AR work instructions to standardise rare or high risk procedures
description: How AR work instructions help operations, HSE, and training teams standardise rare or high risk procedures for safer, more consistent outcomes.

image.alt: Using AR work instructions to standardise rare or high risk procedures

author: ActARion
body:
const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:r}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(i){const a={a:"a",blockquote:"blockquote",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...i.components};return r(e,{children:[r(a.h1,{id:"using-ar-work-instructions-to-standardise-rare-or-high-risk-procedures",children:["Using AR work instructions to standardise rare or high risk procedures",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#using-ar-work-instructions-to-standardise-rare-or-high-risk-procedures",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Industrial teams regularly face procedures that, while rare, carry significant risk. Complex changeovers, emergency shutdowns, confined space entries, and critical maintenance tasks demand absolute precision. Yet, because these procedures are performed infrequently, even experienced technicians and operators can struggle to recall exact steps, increasing the risk of errors, incidents, and downtime."}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Augmented reality (AR) work instructions offer a practical, proven way to standardise these rare or high risk procedures—making work safer, more consistent, and easier to audit."}),"
",r(a.h2,{id:"why-rare-and-high-risk-procedures-remain-a-challenge",children:["Why rare and high risk procedures remain a challenge",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#why-rare-and-high-risk-procedures-remain-a-challenge",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Most industrial sites have robust standard operating procedures (SOPs) for daily tasks. But rare or high risk procedures create unique challenges:"}),"
",r(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Technicians may not have repeated exposure to the steps, so memory fades."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Paper-based SOPs can be overlooked, misinterpreted, or outdated."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Verbal handovers lose detail, especially across shifts or teams."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"High risk tasks often require rapid, correct action under pressure."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Auditors and safety leads need clear evidence of compliance and training."}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"For example, a chemical plant may only perform a full vessel decontamination once a year. A water utility might only isolate major pipelines during emergency repairs. In these cases, a single mistake can lead to injuries, environmental incidents, or costly downtime."}),"
",r(a.p,{children:["Research from the Institution of Chemical Engineers (IChemE) highlights that rare procedures are disproportionately represented in incident reports, largely due to lapses in memory, unclear instructions, or incomplete handovers (",n(a.a,{href:"https://www.icheme.org/",children:"IChemE, 2020"}),")."]}),"
",r(a.h2,{id:"why-now-regulatory-and-workforce-trends-increase-the-need-for-standardisation",children:["Why now: regulatory and workforce trends increase the need for standardisation",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#why-now-regulatory-and-workforce-trends-increase-the-need-for-standardisation",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Several trends are converging to make standardisation of rare and high risk procedures a top priority:"}),"
",r(a.ul,{children:["
",r(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Stricter regulatory requirements"})," for evidence-based training and procedural compliance."]}),"
",r(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Aging workforce"})," and increased turnover, leading to loss of institutional knowledge."]}),"
",r(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"More complex equipment"})," and interconnected systems, raising the stakes for error."]}),"
",r(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Digital transformation"})," mandates, requiring traceable, auditable processes."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"For operations managers, HSE leads, and training professionals, relying on static documents or informal coaching is no longer enough. Digital solutions that deliver guidance at the point of work—and capture proof of execution—are now essential for operational excellence."}),"
",r(a.h2,{id:"how-ar-work-instructions-support-safer-more-consistent-execution",children:["How AR work instructions support safer, more consistent execution",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-ar-work-instructions-support-safer-more-consistent-execution",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"AR work instructions combine visual, step-by-step guidance with real-time data and context. Delivered via smart glasses, tablets, or mobile devices, they overlay digital instructions onto the physical workspace, making each step clear and unambiguous."}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Key features include:"}),"
",r(a.ul,{children:["
",r(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Visual overlays:"})," Diagrams, animations, and markers that show exactly where to act."]}),"
",r(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Interactive checklists:"})," Require confirmation or input before proceeding."]}),"
",r(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Embedded reference materials:"})," Safety data sheets, equipment manuals, or video clips."]}),"
",r(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Contextual prompts:"})," Adapt instructions based on sensor data or operator input."]}),"
",r(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Automated documentation:"})," Capture time-stamped records, photos, and digital sign-offs."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"This approach addresses the core risks of rare or high risk procedures:"}),"
",r(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Reduces reliance on memory or paper."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Ensures critical steps are not skipped or performed out of sequence."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Supports less experienced team members with just-in-time knowledge."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Provides real-time support for troubleshooting or escalation."}),"
"]}),"
",r(a.blockquote,{children:["
",r(a.p,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Note:"})," A 2022 study by the Fraunhofer Institute found that AR-guided procedures reduced error rates by 40% and improved procedural compliance by over 30% in pharmaceutical and chemical manufacturing."]}),"
"]}),"
",r(a.h2,{id:"use-cases-where-ar-sops-make-the-biggest-impact",children:["Use cases: where AR SOPs make the biggest impact",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#use-cases-where-ar-sops-make-the-biggest-impact",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"AR work instructions are particularly valuable for procedures where the stakes are high and repetition is low. Common industrial use cases include:"}),"
",r(a.h3,{id:"emergency-shutdowns-and-lockouttagout-loto",children:["Emergency shutdowns and lockout/tagout (LOTO)",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#emergency-shutdowns-and-lockouttagout-loto",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"When a line or facility must be safely powered down, every step matters. AR SOPs guide technicians through the correct sequence, confirm each isolation point, and record proof of execution—minimising the risk of accidental energisation."}),"
",r(a.h3,{id:"confined-space-entries",children:["Confined space entries",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#confined-space-entries",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"AR-guided checklists ensure all pre-entry safety checks, atmospheric tests, and permit requirements are completed and documented before anyone enters a vessel or tank. Visual overlays help identify access points and hazards."}),"
",r(a.h3,{id:"critical-maintenance-and-calibrations",children:["Critical maintenance and calibrations",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#critical-maintenance-and-calibrations",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"For tasks like pressure relief valve replacement or instrument calibration, AR SOPs show the correct tools, torque values, and sequence—reducing the risk of leaks, contamination, or misalignment."}),"
",r(a.h3,{id:"complex-changeovers-and-commissioning",children:["Complex changeovers and commissioning",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#complex-changeovers-and-commissioning",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"During product changeovers or equipment commissioning, AR work instructions help teams avoid cross-contamination, missed cleaning steps, or configuration errors, especially when procedures are infrequent."}),"
",r(a.h3,{id:"incident-response-and-troubleshooting",children:["Incident response and troubleshooting",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#incident-response-and-troubleshooting",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"AR SOPs can provide immediate, step-by-step guidance during fire alarms, chemical spills, or equipment failures—helping operators respond correctly while capturing an audit trail for later review."}),"

",i(r.h2,{id:"regulated-industries-face-rising-pressure-on-quality-and-compliance",children:["Regulated industries face rising pressure on quality and compliance",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#regulated-industries-face-rising-pressure-on-quality-and-compliance",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"

"]}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"measurable-results-compliance-quality-and-productivity-gains",children:["Measurable results: compliance, quality, and productivity gains",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#measurable-results-compliance-quality-and-productivity-gains",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Companies implementing AR and AI for quality inspections and audits report:"}),"

",i(r.li,{children:["30–50% faster inspection cycles (source: Capgemini, ",n(r.a,{href:"https://www.capgemini.com/research/augmented-and-virtual-reality-in-operations/",children:"Augmented and Virtual Reality in Operations"}),")"]}),"

",n(r.p,{children:"ActARion’s approach combines proven technology with practical support for change management and regulatory compliance."}),"
