author: ActARion
body:
const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(r){const a={a:"a",blockquote:"blockquote",br:"br",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",hr:"hr",li:"li",ol:"ol",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...r.components};return i(e,{children:[i(a.h1,{id:"comparing-solutions-what-to-look-for-when-selecting-an-ar-knowledge-platform",children:["Comparing solutions: what to look for when selecting an AR knowledge platform",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#comparing-solutions-what-to-look-for-when-selecting-an-ar-knowledge-platform",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Augmented reality (AR) knowledge platforms are changing how industrial teams work. For operations managers, HSE leaders, maintenance leads, and L&D professionals, the right AR solution can mean the difference between safe, compliant, and high-performing operations—or costly mistakes and downtime. But with a crowded market, comparing solutions and making the right choice is not straightforward."}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"This article breaks down what matters most when selecting an AR knowledge platform for industrial use. It covers the practical criteria, must-have features, and concrete steps to ensure your investment delivers measurable improvements in safety, productivity, and workforce readiness."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"the-need-for-robust-ar-knowledge-platforms-in-industry",children:["The need for robust AR knowledge platforms in industry",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#the-need-for-robust-ar-knowledge-platforms-in-industry",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Industrial environments face increasing complexity and pressure. Assets are more advanced, compliance demands are stricter, and skilled personnel are harder to find. At the same time, unplanned downtime, procedural errors, and safety incidents remain constant threats."}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Traditional paper SOPs and static digital documents are not enough. Teams need just-in-time, context-aware guidance—especially for critical inspections, maintenance, and onboarding. AR knowledge platforms, which combine digital work instructions, AI-driven guidance, and real-time data, respond directly to these needs."}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"current-challenges-driving-ar-adoption",children:["Current challenges driving AR adoption",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#current-challenges-driving-ar-adoption",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Skills gaps and experienced staff retiring, making knowledge capture and transfer urgent"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"High stakes for safety and compliance; mistakes can be costly or dangerous"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Time pressure to get new technicians or operators up to speed fast"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Demands for consistent quality and uptime across distributed teams"}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.p,{children:["A 2023 McKinsey report found that digital work instructions and AR SOPs can reduce error rates by up to 50% and cut training time by 30–40% in industrial settings (",n(a.a,{href:"https://www.mckinsey.com/industries/advanced-electronics/our-insights/how-augmented-reality-can-accelerate-manufacturing",children:"source"}),"). But real results depend on selecting a platform that fits your operational reality."]}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"why-careful-comparison-matters-now",children:["Why careful comparison matters now",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#why-careful-comparison-matters-now",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Selecting an AR knowledge platform is not just about features—it’s about fit, scalability, and long-term value. Industrial decision makers need to justify investments and prove ROI. A poorly matched platform can lead to:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Low adoption among teams"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Difficult integrations with existing systems"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Content bottlenecks or quality issues"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Security or compliance risks"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Missed productivity and safety targets"}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"The market for AR knowledge solutions is evolving fast. New vendors appear regularly, but not all can meet the demands of regulated, high-stakes industrial environments. A careful, criteria-based comparison is essential."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"key-criteria-for-evaluating-ar-knowledge-platforms",children:["Key criteria for evaluating AR knowledge platforms",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#key-criteria-for-evaluating-ar-knowledge-platforms",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"The best AR knowledge platforms do more than overlay instructions—they integrate with your workflows, adapt to your teams, and support measurable operational improvements. Use the following criteria to compare solutions:"}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"1-industrial-grade-content-creation-and-management",children:["1. Industrial-grade content creation and management",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#1-industrial-grade-content-creation-and-management",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Flexible authoring:"})," Can your subject matter experts create and update AR SOPs and digital work instructions without coding?"]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Content governance:"})," Does the platform support version control, approval workflows, and audit trails?"]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Media support:"})," Can you combine 3D models, video, step-by-step text, and IoT data in your instructions?"]}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"A robust platform should make it easy to digitize inspections, maintenance routines, and onboarding processes—while ensuring content quality and compliance."}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"2-usability-for-technicians-and-operators",children:["2. Usability for technicians and operators",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#2-usability-for-technicians-and-operators",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Device compatibility:"})," Does the solution work on the hardware your teams use (smartphones, tablets, AR headsets)?"]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"User experience:"})," Are instructions clear, hands-free when needed, and accessible in noisy or hazardous environments?"]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Offline access:"})," Can teams use the platform reliably in areas with limited connectivity?"]}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"User adoption is critical. Platforms that are hard to use or require expensive, specialized hardware often fail to scale beyond pilot projects."}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"3-integration-with-existing-systems",children:["3. Integration with existing systems",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#3-integration-with-existing-systems",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"ERP, EAM, and MES integration:"})," Can the platform connect with your maintenance, asset management, or learning management systems?"]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Single sign-on and user management:"})," Does it support your IT security and identity protocols?"]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Data export and analytics:"})," Can you easily extract usage, compliance, and performance data?"]}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Integration ensures that AR work instructions become part of daily operations rather than a siloed tool."}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"4-ai-driven-guidance-and-analytics",children:["4. AI-driven guidance and analytics",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#4-ai-driven-guidance-and-analytics",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Context-aware assistance:"})," Does the platform use AI to recommend next steps, detect errors, or adapt instructions in real time?"]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Performance tracking:"})," Can you measure completion rates, error types, and time-on-task?"]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Continuous improvement:"})," Is there support for feedback loops, so instructions can be refined based on real-world use?"]}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"AI and AR–guided work instructions should deliver smarter, not just digital, support."}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"5-security-compliance-and-scalability",children:["5. Security, compliance, and scalability",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#5-security-compliance-and-scalability",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Data protection:"})," Does the platform meet industry standards for data security and privacy (e.g., ISO 27001, GDPR)?"]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Access control:"})," Can you manage permissions for different teams, sites, or roles?"]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Scalability:"})," Is the solution proven in environments similar to yours, and can it support growth across sites or regions?"]}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"For regulated industries, security and compliance are non-negotiable."}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"6-support-training-and-change-management",children:["6. Support, training, and change management",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#6-support-training-and-change-management",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Onboarding support:"})," Does the vendor provide resources to help your teams adopt the platform?"]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Change management:"})," Are there templates or best practices for rolling out AR SOPs and digital work instructions?"]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Ongoing support:"})," Is help available when you need it—locally and in your language?"]}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"A platform is only as good as the support and expertise behind it."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"key-use-cases-and-operational-impact",children:["Key use cases and operational impact",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#key-use-cases-and-operational-impact",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Industrial teams use AR knowledge platforms to improve safety, productivity, and training in several high-impact areas:"}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"ar-sops-for-inspections-and-maintenance",children:["AR SOPs for inspections and maintenance",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#ar-sops-for-inspections-and-maintenance",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Step-by-step, visual instructions guide technicians through complex inspections, reducing missed steps."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Real-time data from sensors or IoT devices can be integrated to trigger specific instructions or warnings."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Digital checklists ensure compliance and create an auditable record for regulators."}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"digital-onboarding-and-upskilling",children:["Digital onboarding and upskilling",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#digital-onboarding-and-upskilling",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"New operators follow interactive procedures, accelerating time to competence."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Less dependence on shadowing experienced staff, freeing up senior technicians for critical tasks."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Training content is always up to date, avoiding out-of-date paper manuals."}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"remote-support-and-collaboration",children:["Remote support and collaboration",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#remote-support-and-collaboration",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Field engineers can connect with remote experts, who see what they see and guide them in real time."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Complex troubleshooting is faster, reducing downtime and travel costs."}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"quality-assurance-and-compliance",children:["Quality assurance and compliance",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#quality-assurance-and-compliance",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Every step is documented, with photos, videos, or sensor data as proof of execution."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Immediate feedback and error detection help prevent defects and incidents."}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.blockquote,{children:["
",i(a.p,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Note:"})," For more on how AR onboarding can reduce error rates and speed up training, see ",n(a.a,{href:"/use-cases/ar-onboarding",children:"AR onboarding for technicians"}),"."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"how-to-structure-an-effective-comparison-process",children:["How to structure an effective comparison process",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-to-structure-an-effective-comparison-process",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"A structured evaluation process helps avoid common pitfalls and ensures the chosen AR knowledge platform delivers results:"}),"
",i(a.ol,{children:["
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Define your objectives:"})," Identify the processes (e.g., inspections, maintenance, onboarding) where AR SOPs would have the most impact."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Engage stakeholders early:"})," Include IT, HSE, operations, and training leads in requirements gathering."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Pilot with real workflows:"})," Test shortlisted platforms in real use cases—not just vendor demos."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Evaluate content creation:"})," Have your subject matter experts create or update digital work instructions to test ease of use."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Check integration and security:"})," Validate how the platform fits with your IT landscape and compliance needs."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Assess support and roadmap:"})," Interview vendors about their industrial experience, support structure, and product roadmap."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Document findings using a clear scorecard or checklist. Focus on operational impact, not just features."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"addressing-common-objections-and-limitations",children:["Addressing common objections and limitations",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#addressing-common-objections-and-limitations",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Implementing AR knowledge platforms in industrial settings does present challenges. Decision makers should be aware of:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Hardware readiness:"})," Not all teams have access to AR headsets; ensure the platform supports smartphones and tablets."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Change management:"})," Teams may resist new tools. Success depends on clear communication, training, and leadership support."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Content creation workload:"})," Building high-quality digital work instructions requires up-front effort. Look for platforms with templates and efficient authoring tools."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Data privacy:"})," Ensure the platform meets your industry’s data governance requirements."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Vendors should be transparent about these challenges and provide strategies to address them."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"what-actarion-brings-to-industrial-ar-knowledge-management",children:["What ActARion brings to industrial AR knowledge management",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#what-actarion-brings-to-industrial-ar-knowledge-management",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"ActARion specializes in AI and AR–guided work instructions for industrial environments. Our platform is built for operations, HSE, maintenance, and training leaders who need measurable improvements in safety, compliance, and productivity."}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Key strengths include:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Industrial-grade authoring:"})," No-code creation and easy updates for AR SOPs, digital inspections, and onboarding content."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Flexible deployment:"})," Support for smartphones, tablets, and leading AR headsets—online or offline."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Seamless integration:"})," Proven connectors for EAM, ERP, and training systems."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"AI-driven guidance:"})," Context-aware assistance and analytics for continuous improvement."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Compliance built-in:"})," End-to-end audit trails, access controls, and data protection aligned with industry standards."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Change management support:"})," Templates, onboarding resources, and expert support to ensure adoption and ROI."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"ActARion works with manufacturers, utilities, and technical service providers to digitize critical procedures and empower teams with just-in-time knowledge."}),"
",i(a.p,{children:["For more details, see ",n(a.a,{href:"/about",children:"About ActARion"})," or review our ",n(a.a,{href:"/faq/ar-knowledge-platforms",children:"FAQ on AR knowledge platforms"}),"."]}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"explore-this-in-your-organisation",children:["Explore this in your organisation",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#explore-this-in-your-organisation",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Selecting the right AR knowledge platform is a strategic decision with direct impact on safety, productivity, and workforce readiness. To see how AI and AR–guided work instructions could support your operational goals, schedule an exploratory call with ActARion. There is no commitment—just a practical look at your processes and how digital work instructions can drive results."}),"
",i(a.p,{children:["Learn more about ",n(a.a,{href:"/use-cases/digital-maintenance-instructions",children:"digital work instructions for maintenance"})," or see how ",n(a.a,{href:"/explainer/ai-ar-sops",children:"AI and AR–guided SOPs"})," fit your workflows. For a broader perspective, read the ",n(a.a,{href:"https://www.mckinsey.com/industries/advanced-electronics/our-insights/how-augmented-reality-can-accelerate-manufacturing",children:"McKinsey analysis on AR in manufacturing"}),"."]}),"

title: Cybersicherheit und Datenschutz beim Bereitstellen von AR und KI in Operationen
description: Erfahren Sie, wie Sie Cybersicherheits- und Datenschutz-Herausforderungen beim Implementieren von AR und KI in industriellen Operationen adressieren. Für Operations-, HSE- und IT-Leiter.

image.alt: Cybersicherheit und Datenschutz beim Bereitstellen von AR und KI in Operationen

author: ActARion
body:
const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(r){const t={a:"a",br:"br",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...r.components};return i(e,{children:[i(t.h1,{id:"cybersicherheit-und-datenschutz-beim-bereitstellen-von-ar-und-ki-in-operationen",children:["Cybersicherheit und Datenschutz beim Bereitstellen von AR und KI in Operationen",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#cybersicherheit-und-datenschutz-beim-bereitstellen-von-ar-und-ki-in-operationen",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Augmented Reality (AR) und Künstliche Intelligenz (KI) transformieren industrielle Operationen. Unternehmen verwenden AR- und KI-gestützte Arbeitsanweisungen, um Inspektionen zu digitalisieren, Verfahren zu standardisieren und Schulungen zu beschleunigen. Aber während diese Tools Geräte, Daten und Teams verbinden, entstehen neue Risiken rund um Cybersicherheit und Datenschutz. Für Operations-, HSE- und IT-Leiter ist die Gewährleistung, dass AR- und KI-Bereitstellungen sicher sind, jetzt ein nicht verhandelbarer Teil der digitalen Transformation."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"steigende-adoption-von-ar-und-ki-in-industriellen-umgebungen",children:["Steigende Adoption von AR und KI in industriellen Umgebungen",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#steigende-adoption-von-ar-und-ki-in-industriellen-umgebungen",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Industrielle Organisationen stehen unter Druck, Produktivität zu optimieren, hohe Sicherheitsstandards aufrechtzuerhalten und Wissen effizient zu übertragen. AR- und KI-gestützte Arbeitsanweisungen adressieren diese Bedürfnisse:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Feldingenieure verwenden AR-Headsets, um digitale SOPs handenfreie zu befolgen."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Wartungsleiter nutzen KI, um Anomalien während Inspektionen zu markieren."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Trainingsmanager beschleunigen Onboarding mit interaktiver, Echtzeit-Anleitung."}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.p,{children:["Laut ",n(t.a,{href:"https://www.pwc.com/gx/en/issues/technology/ai-analysis.html",children:"PwC"})," planen über 70% der Industrieunternehmen, ihre Investitionen in KI bis 2025 zu erhöhen. Die AR-Adoption beschleunigt sich auch, da Hardware praktischer wird und Content-Erstellungstools reifen."]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Aber während diese Technologien von Piloten zu Produktion wechseln, erweitert sich die Angriffsfläche. Geräte mit Kameras und Mikrofonen, cloud-verbundene Analytics und Echtzeit-Datenaustausch stellen alle neue Einstiegspunkte für Cyber-Bedrohungen und Datenschutzverletzungen dar."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"warum-cybersicherheit-und-datenschutz-dringende-aufmerksamkeit-erfordern",children:["Warum Cybersicherheit und Datenschutz dringende Aufmerksamkeit erfordern",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#warum-cybersicherheit-und-datenschutz-dringende-aufmerksamkeit-erfordern",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Industrielle Operationen handhaben sensible Informationen: Produktionsparameter, Ausrüstungsstatus, Sicherheitsvorfälle und manchmal personenbezogene Daten über Techniker. Wenn AR- und KI-Plattformen eingeführt werden, werden die folgenden Risiken dringender:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Unbefugter Zugang:"})," AR-Geräte und verbundene Plattformen können für Credential-Diebstahl oder unbefugte Zugriffsversuche ins Visier genommen werden."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Datenabfangen:"})," Echtzeit-Video, Sensordaten und Arbeitsprotokolle, die über Netzwerke übertragen werden, können abgefangen werden, wenn nicht ordnungsgemäß verschlüsselt."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Datenschutzverletzungen:"})," Geräte sammeln oft Audio-, Video- und Standortdaten, die GDPR oder anderen Datenschutzbestimmungen unterliegen können."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Malware und Ransomware:"})," KI-Algorithmen und AR-Geräte sind potenzielle Vektoren für Malware, wenn nicht gesichert und regelmäßig aktualisiert."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Verlust der operativen Integrität:"})," Kompromittierte digitale Arbeitsanweisungen können zu unsicheren Verfahren oder Qualitätslücken führen."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.p,{children:["Ein ",n(t.a,{href:"https://www.sans.org/white-papers/industrial-cybersecurity-2023-survey/",children:"SANS-Bericht von 2023"})," ergab, dass 40% der Industrieorganisationen im vergangenen Jahr ein Cybersicherheitsvorfall erlebten, der operative Technologie (OT) betraf. Die Kosten einer Verletzung gehen über Ausfallzeiten hinaus—regulatorische Bußgelder, Reputationsschäden und Verlust geistigen Eigentums sind echte Risiken."]}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"wie-ar--und-ki-gestützte-arbeitsanweisungen-neue-sicherheitsherausforderungen-einführen",children:["Wie AR- und KI-gestützte Arbeitsanweisungen neue Sicherheitsherausforderungen einführen",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#wie-ar--und-ki-gestützte-arbeitsanweisungen-neue-sicherheitsherausforderungen-einführen",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Traditionelle IT- und OT-Systeme in industriellen Umgebungen sind oft isoliert, mit klaren Grenzen und Kontrollen. AR und KI ändern dies auf mehrere Weise:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Geräteproliferation:"})," AR-Headsets, Tablets und Mobilgeräte vervielfachen die Anzahl der Endpunkte, die Schutz benötigen."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Cloud-Konnektivität:"})," Viele AR- und KI-Plattformen verlassen sich auf cloud-basierte Analytics und Speicherung, werfen Fragen zur Datenresidenz und Zugang Dritter auf."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Benutzergenerierte Inhalte:"})," Teams können Fotos, Videos oder Notizen zu digitalen Arbeitsanweisungen hochladen, erhöhen das Volumen und die Sensibilität gespeicherter Daten."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Integrationskomplexität:"})," Das Verbinden von AR-SOPs mit Legacy-Systemen, Asset-Datenbanken oder ERP-Tools führt Integrationspunkte ein, die auch gesichert werden müssen."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Jede neue Schnittstelle oder Integration ist eine potenzielle Schwachstelle. Ohne robuste Governance können diese Risiken schnell die Vorteile der Digitalisierung überholen."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"schlüsselanforderungen-für-sichere-und-konforme-ar--und-ki-bereitstellungen",children:["Schlüsselanforderungen für sichere und konforme AR- und KI-Bereitstellungen",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#schlüsselanforderungen-für-sichere-und-konforme-ar--und-ki-bereitstellungen",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Operations- und IT-Leiter müssen zusammenarbeiten, um sicherzustellen, dass AR- und KI-gestützte Arbeitsanweisungen strenge Sicherheits- und Datenschutzstandards erfüllen. Schlüsselanforderungen umfassen:"}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"geräte--und-netzwerksicherheit",children:["Geräte- und Netzwerksicherheit",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#geräte--und-netzwerksicherheit",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Erfordern Sie starke Authentifizierung (z.B. Multi-Faktor-Authentifizierung) für alle AR- und KI-Geräte."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Erzwingen Sie regelmäßige Software-Updates und Geräte-Patching."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Verwenden Sie sicheres Wi-Fi, VPN oder private 5G-Netzwerke für On-Site-Konnektivität."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Segmentieren Sie AR- und KI-Verkehr von kritischen OT-Netzwerken, wo möglich."}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"datenschutz-und-datenschutz",children:["Datenschutz und Datenschutz",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#datenschutz-und-datenschutz",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Verschlüsseln Sie alle Daten im Ruhezustand und während der Übertragung, besonders Video, Audio und Sensor-Streams."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Speichern Sie sensible Daten in sicheren, konformen Cloud-Umgebungen oder vor Ort nach Bedarf."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Implementieren Sie Zugriffskontrollen und Audit-Protokolle, um zu verfolgen, wer auf digitale Arbeitsanweisungen zugegriffen oder sie geändert hat."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Minimieren Sie Datenerfassung auf das, was für Operationen oder Compliance notwendig ist."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Anonymisieren oder pseudonymisieren Sie personenbezogene Daten, wo möglich."}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"governance-und-compliance",children:["Governance und Compliance",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#governance-und-compliance",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Mappen Sie Datenflüsse und Speicherorte für alle AR- und KI-fähigen Prozesse."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Führen Sie Datenschutz-Folgenabschätzungen durch, besonders wenn personenbezogene Daten oder Daten verarbeitet werden, die GDPR, CCPA oder lokalen Gesetzen unterliegen."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Pflegen Sie klare Richtlinien zu Datenaufbewahrung, -löschung und Betroffenenanfragen."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Schulen Sie Teams in sicherem Gerätegebrauch und Melden verdächtiger Aktivitäten."}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"anbieter-due-diligence",children:["Anbieter-Due-Diligence",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#anbieter-due-diligence",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Bewerten Sie AR- und KI-Plattform-Anbieter auf Sicherheitszertifizierungen (z.B. ISO 27001, SOC 2)."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Überprüfen Sie Listen von Drittanbieter-Unterauftragsnehmern und Datenschutzvereinbarungen."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Erfordern Sie regelmäßige Penetrationstests und Schwachstellen-Offenlegungen."}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"praktische-anwendungsfälle-sichere-ar-und-ki-in-aktion",children:["Praktische Anwendungsfälle: Sichere AR und KI in Aktion",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#praktische-anwendungsfälle-sichere-ar-und-ki-in-aktion",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Um zu veranschaulichen, wie sichere Bereitstellung aussieht, betrachten Sie diese real-world-Szenarien:"}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"digitalisierung-von-sicherheitsinspektionen-mit-ar-sops",children:["Digitalisierung von Sicherheitsinspektionen mit AR-SOPs",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#digitalisierung-von-sicherheitsinspektionen-mit-ar-sops",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Ein europäischer Chemiehersteller stattet Operatoren mit AR-Brillen aus, um tägliche Sicherheitsinspektionen durchzuführen. Die AR-SOPs führen jeden Schritt, erfassen Fotos und protokollieren Ergebnisse direkt in eine sichere Cloud. Nur autorisierte Supervisoren können Inspektionsdaten überprüfen, und alle Übertragungen sind verschlüsselt. Gerätezugang ist auf firmenausgestellte Berechtigungen beschränkt, und Protokolle werden gemäß regulatorischen Anforderungen aufbewahrt."}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"ki-gestützte-qualitätskontrolle-mit-datenschutzsicherungen",children:["KI-gestützte Qualitätskontrolle mit Datenschutzsicherungen",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#ki-gestützte-qualitätskontrolle-mit-datenschutzsicherungen",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Ein Automobilwerk verwendet KI, um Video-Feeds von AR-ausgestatteten Technikern zu analysieren, die Montageprüfungen durchführen. Die KI markiert Abweichungen in Echtzeit, aber alle Videos werden anonymisiert, um Gesichter und persönliche Identifikatoren vor der Speicherung zu entfernen. Nur Zusammenfassungsdaten werden mit Qualitätsteams geteilt, und Aufnahmen werden nach 30 Tagen gelöscht, es sei denn, sie werden für Vorfalluntersuchungen benötigt."}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"remote-unterstützung-mit-strengen-zugriffskontrollen",children:["Remote-Unterstützung mit strengen Zugriffskontrollen",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#remote-unterstützung-mit-strengen-zugriffskontrollen",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Ein Wartungsleiter im Energiesektor verwendet AR, um Feldingenieure mit Remote-Experten zu verbinden. Live-Video-Feeds sind Ende-zu-Ende verschlüsselt, und Sitzungsprotokolle werden für Audits aufbewahrt. Remote-Experten können nur während geplanter Support-Fenster auf den Feed zugreifen und können Aufnahmen nicht ohne ausdrückliche Zustimmung aufzeichnen oder herunterladen."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"In jedem Fall sind robuste Cybersicherheits- und Datenschutzmaßnahmen sowohl in den Technologie-Stack als auch in die Betriebsverfahren eingebaut."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"adressieren-häufiger-einwände-und-einschränkungen",children:["Adressieren häufiger Einwände und Einschränkungen",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#adressieren-häufiger-einwände-und-einschränkungen",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Entscheidungsträger äußern oft berechtigte Bedenken bei der Bewertung von AR- und KI-Bereitstellungen:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:["
",i(t.p,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:'"Wir können unser Produktionsnetzwerk nicht riskieren, es zu exponieren."'}),n(t.br,{}),"
","Netzwerksegmentierung, Gerätehärtung und sichere Gateways ermöglichen AR- und KI-Verkehr, ohne Kern-OT-Systeme zu kompromittieren."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:["
",i(t.p,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:'"Wie stellen wir GDPR- oder CCPA-Compliance sicher?"'}),n(t.br,{}),"
","Dataminimierung, transparente Einwilligungsprozesse und klare Datenfluss-Mapping sind wesentlich. Wählen Sie Anbieter mit starken Erfolgsbilanz in industrieller Compliance."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:["
",i(t.p,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:'"Was ist mit von Technikern erstellten Inhalten?"'}),n(t.br,{}),"
","Implementieren Sie automatische Content-Klassifizierung, Zugriffskontrollen und Aufbewahrungsrichtlinien für benutzergenerierte Fotos, Videos und Notizen."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:["
",i(t.p,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:'"Sind AR-Geräte selbst ein schwaches Glied?"'}),n(t.br,{}),"
","Standardisieren Sie auf genehmigte Geräte, erzwingen Sie regelmäßige Updates und beschränken Sie die Installation nicht autorisierter Apps."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:["
",i(t.p,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:'"Change Management ist eine Herausforderung."'}),n(t.br,{}),"
","Beziehen Sie IT-, Operations- und HSE-Teams früh ein. Bieten Sie gezielte Schulungen und klare Eskalationswege für Sicherheitsvorfälle."]}),"
"]}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"was-actarion-zu-sicherer-ar--und-ki-bereitstellung-beiträgt",children:["Was ActARion zu sicherer AR- und KI-Bereitstellung beiträgt",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#was-actarion-zu-sicherer-ar--und-ki-bereitstellung-beiträgt",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"ActARion arbeitet mit Industrieorganisationen zusammen, um KI- und AR-gestützte Arbeitsanweisungen zu liefern, die den höchsten Standards für Cybersicherheit und Datenschutz entsprechen. Unser Ansatz umfasst:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Ende-zu-Ende-Verschlüsselung:"})," Alle Daten, vom Gerät bis zur Cloud, werden mit Industriestandards verschlüsselt."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Rollenbasierte Zugriffskontrollen:"})," Nur autorisiertes Personal kann digitale Arbeitsanweisungen und zugehörige Daten erstellen, bearbeiten oder überprüfen."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Umfassende Audit-Trails:"})," Jeder Zugriff und jede Änderung wird für Compliance und forensische Analyse protokolliert."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Flexible Bereitstellung:"})," Wählen Sie sichere Cloud- oder On-Premises-Hosting, um Ihre Sicherheits- und Datenresidenz-Bedürfnisse zu erfüllen."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Datenschutz durch Design:"})," Personenbezogene Daten werden minimiert, anonymisiert oder ausgeschlossen, wo möglich; Datenschutz-Folgenabschätzungen sind Standard."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Integration mit bestehender IT/OT-Sicherheit:"})," Wir richten uns an Ihre Netzwerkrichtlinien, Geräteverwaltung und Vorfallreaktionsverfahren aus."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Change-Management-Unterstützung:"})," Wir unterstützen Ihre Teams mit Schulung, Dokumentation und sicheren Onboarding-Prozessen."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Durch Partnerschaft mit ActARion erhalten Sie einen glaubwürdigen, erfahrenen Anbieter, der die Realitäten industrieller Cybersicherheit und Compliance versteht."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"erkunden-sie-sichere-ar--und-ki-arbeitsanweisungen-in-ihren-operationen",children:["Erkunden Sie sichere AR- und KI-Arbeitsanweisungen in Ihren Operationen",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#erkunden-sie-sichere-ar--und-ki-arbeitsanweisungen-in-ihren-operationen",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Die Sicherung von AR- und KI-gestützten Arbeitsanweisungen ist wesentlich für sichere, produktive und konforme industrielle Operationen. Um zu sehen, wie dies in Ihrer Umgebung funktionieren könnte, vereinbaren Sie einen explorativen Discovery Call mit ActARion. Besprechen Sie Ihre spezifischen Sicherheitsanforderungen und erfahren Sie, wie unser Ansatz Ihnen helfen kann, Prozesse zu digitalisieren, ohne Sicherheit oder Datenschutz zu kompromittieren."}),"
",i(t.p,{children:["Um mehr zu erfahren, sehen Sie unsere detaillierte ",n(t.a,{href:"/de/faq/ar-data-security",children:"FAQ zu AR-Datensicherheit"})," und lesen Sie über ",n(t.a,{href:"/de/use-cases/ar-onboarding",children:"AR-Onboarding für Techniker"}),". Für eine Branchenperspektive zu Cybersicherheits-Best-Practices besuchen Sie die ",n(t.a,{href:"https://www.enisa.europa.eu/publications/good-practices-for-security-of-iot",children:"ENISA-Richtlinien zur Sicherung von industriellem IoT"}),"."]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Dies ist ein risikofreies, exploratives Gespräch—keine Verpflichtung erforderlich."})]})}return{default:function(e={}){const{wrapper:i}=e.components||{};return i?n(i,{...e,children:n(_createMdxContent,{...e})}):_createMdxContent(e)}};

title: Cybersecurity en gegevensprivacy bij het deployen van AR en AI in operaties
description: Leer hoe cybersecurity- en gegevensprivacy-uitdagingen aan te pakken bij het implementeren van AR en AI in industriële operaties. Voor operations-, HSE- en IT-leiders.

image.alt: Cybersecurity en gegevensprivacy bij het deployen van AR en AI in operaties

author: ActARion
body:
const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(r){const a={a:"a",br:"br",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...r.components};return i(e,{children:[i(a.h1,{id:"cybersecurity-en-gegevensprivacy-bij-het-deployen-van-ar-en-ai-in-operaties",children:["Cybersecurity en gegevensprivacy bij het deployen van AR en AI in operaties",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#cybersecurity-en-gegevensprivacy-bij-het-deployen-van-ar-en-ai-in-operaties",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Augmented reality (AR) en artificial intelligence (AI) transformeren industriële operaties. Bedrijven gebruiken AR- en AI-geleide werkvoorschriften om inspecties te digitaliseren, procedures te standaardiseren en training te versnellen. Maar naarmate deze tools apparaten, data en teams verbinden, ontstaan nieuwe risico's rond cybersecurity en gegevensprivacy. Voor operations-, HSE- en IT-leiders is het waarborgen dat AR- en AI-deployments veilig zijn nu een niet-onderhandelbaar onderdeel van digitale transformatie."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"toenemende-adoptie-van-ar-en-ai-in-industriële-omgevingen",children:["Toenemende adoptie van AR en AI in industriële omgevingen",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#toenemende-adoptie-van-ar-en-ai-in-industriële-omgevingen",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Industriële organisaties staan onder druk om productiviteit te optimaliseren, hoge veiligheidsstandaarden te handhaven en kennis efficiënt over te dragen. AR- en AI-geleide werkvoorschriften adresseren deze behoeften:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Veldengineers gebruiken AR-headsets om digitale SOPs handenvrij te volgen."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Onderhoudsleiders benutten AI om anomalieën te markeren tijdens inspecties."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Trainingsmanagers versnellen onboarding met interactieve, real-time begeleiding."}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.p,{children:["Volgens ",n(a.a,{href:"https://www.pwc.com/gx/en/issues/technology/ai-analysis.html",children:"PwC"})," plant meer dan 70% van industriële bedrijven hun investering in AI te verhogen tegen 2025. AR-adoptie versnelt ook naarmate hardware praktischer wordt en contentcreatie-tools volwassen worden."]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Maar naarmate deze technologieën verschuiven van pilots naar productie, breidt het aanvalsoppervlak uit. Apparaten met camera's en microfoons, cloud-verbonden analytics en real-time datadeling presenteren allemaal nieuwe toegangspunten voor cyberbedreigingen en privacy-inbreuken."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"waarom-cybersecurity-en-gegevensprivacy-urgente-aandacht-vereisen",children:["Waarom cybersecurity en gegevensprivacy urgente aandacht vereisen",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#waarom-cybersecurity-en-gegevensprivacy-urgente-aandacht-vereisen",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Industriële operaties handelen gevoelige informatie: productieparameters, apparatuurstatus, veiligheidsincidenten en soms persoonsgegevens over technici. Wanneer AR- en AI-platforms worden geïntroduceerd, worden de volgende risico's urgenter:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Ongeautoriseerde toegang:"})," AR-apparaten en verbonden platforms kunnen worden getarget voor credential-diefstal of ongeautoriseerde toegangspogingen."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Data-interceptie:"})," Real-time video, sensordata en werklogs verzonden over netwerken kunnen worden onderschept indien niet correct versleuteld."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Privacy-inbreuken:"})," Apparaten verzamelen vaak audio, video en locatiedata die onderworpen kunnen zijn aan GDPR of andere privacyregelgeving."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Malware en ransomware:"})," AI-algoritmes en AR-apparaten zijn potentiële vectoren voor malware indien niet beveiligd en regelmatig bijgewerkt."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Verlies van operationele integriteit:"})," Gecompromitteerde digitale werkvoorschriften kunnen leiden tot onveilige procedures of kwaliteitslekken."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.p,{children:["Een ",n(a.a,{href:"https://www.sans.org/white-papers/industrial-cybersecurity-2023-survey/",children:"SANS-rapport uit 2023"})," vond dat 40% van industriële organisaties een cybersecurity-incident ervoer dat operationele technologie (OT) beïnvloedde in het afgelopen jaar. De kosten van een inbreuk gaan verder dan downtime—regelgevingsboetes, reputatieschade en verlies van intellectueel eigendom zijn echte risico's."]}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"hoe-ar--en-ai-geleide-werkvoorschriften-nieuwe-beveiligingsuitdagingen-introduceren",children:["Hoe AR- en AI-geleide werkvoorschriften nieuwe beveiligingsuitdagingen introduceren",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#hoe-ar--en-ai-geleide-werkvoorschriften-nieuwe-beveiligingsuitdagingen-introduceren",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Traditionele IT- en OT-systemen in industriële omgevingen zijn vaak gesiloed, met duidelijke grenzen en controles. AR en AI veranderen dit op verschillende manieren:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Apparaatproliferatie:"})," AR-headsets, tablets en mobiele apparaten vermenigvuldigen het aantal endpoints dat bescherming nodig heeft."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Cloud-connectiviteit:"})," Veel AR- en AI-platforms vertrouwen op cloud-gebaseerde analytics en opslag, wat vragen oproept over dataresidency en toegang van derden."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Gebruikersgegenereerde content:"})," Teams kunnen foto's, video's of notities uploaden naar digitale werkvoorschriften, wat het volume en de gevoeligheid van opgeslagen data verhoogt."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Integratiecomplexiteit:"})," Het verbinden van AR SOPs met legacy-systemen, assetdatabases of ERP-tools introduceert integratiepunten die ook moeten worden beveiligd."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Elk nieuw interface of integratie is een potentiële kwetsbaarheid. Zonder robuuste governance kunnen deze risico's snel de voordelen van digitalisatie overtreffen."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"belangrijke-vereisten-voor-veilige-en-compliant-ar--en-ai-deployments",children:["Belangrijke vereisten voor veilige en compliant AR- en AI-deployments",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#belangrijke-vereisten-voor-veilige-en-compliant-ar--en-ai-deployments",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Operations- en IT-leiders moeten samenwerken om ervoor te zorgen dat AR- en AI-geleide werkvoorschriften voldoen aan strikte beveiligings- en privacystandaarden. Belangrijke vereisten zijn:"}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"apparaat--en-netwerkbeveiliging",children:["Apparaat- en netwerkbeveiliging",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#apparaat--en-netwerkbeveiliging",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Vereis sterke authenticatie (bijv. multi-factor authenticatie) voor alle AR- en AI-apparaten."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Dwing regelmatige software-updates en apparaatpatching af."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Gebruik beveiligde Wi-Fi, VPN of private 5G-netwerken voor on-site connectiviteit."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Segmenteer AR- en AI-verkeer van kritieke OT-netwerken waar mogelijk."}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"gegevensbescherming-en-privacy",children:["Gegevensbescherming en privacy",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#gegevensbescherming-en-privacy",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Versleutel alle data at rest en in transit, vooral video, audio en sensorstreams."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Sla gevoelige data op in beveiligde, compliant cloud-omgevingen of on-premises indien nodig."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Implementeer toegangscontroles en auditlogs om te volgen wie toegang had tot of digitale werkvoorschriften wijzigde."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Minimaliseer datacollectie tot wat nodig is voor operaties of compliance."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Anonimiseer of pseudonimiseer persoonsgegevens waar mogelijk."}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"governance-en-compliance",children:["Governance en compliance",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#governance-en-compliance",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Map dataflows en opslaglocaties voor alle AR- en AI-enabled processen."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Voer privacy impact assessments uit, vooral als u persoonsgegevens of data onderworpen aan GDPR, CCPA of lokale wetten verwerkt."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Handhaaf duidelijke beleidsregels over dataretentie, verwijdering en subject access requests."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Train teams over veilig apparaatgebruik en het rapporteren van verdachte activiteit."}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"leverancier-due-diligence",children:["Leverancier due diligence",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#leverancier-due-diligence",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Evalueer AR- en AI-platformleveranciers op beveiligingscertificeringen (bijv. ISO 27001, SOC 2)."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Review derde partij subprocessor-lijsten en gegevensbeschermingsovereenkomsten."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Vereis regelmatige penetratietests en kwetsbaarheidsdisclosures."}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"praktische-use-cases-veilige-ar-en-ai-in-actie",children:["Praktische use cases: Veilige AR en AI in actie",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#praktische-use-cases-veilige-ar-en-ai-in-actie",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Om te illustreren hoe veilige deployment eruitziet, overweeg deze real-world scenario's:"}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"veiligheidsinspecties-digitaliseren-met-ar-sops",children:["Veiligheidsinspecties digitaliseren met AR SOPs",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#veiligheidsinspecties-digitaliseren-met-ar-sops",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Een Europese chemische fabrikant rust operators uit met AR-brillen om dagelijkse veiligheidsinspecties uit te voeren. De AR SOPs begeleiden elke stap, vangen foto's op en loggen resultaten direct naar een beveiligde cloud. Alleen geautoriseerde supervisors kunnen inspectiedata reviewen, en alle transmissies zijn versleuteld. Apparaattoegang is beperkt tot bedrijfs-uitgegeven credentials, en logs worden bewaard volgens regelgevingsvereisten."}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"ai-gedreven-kwaliteitscontrole-met-privacy-safeguards",children:["AI-gedreven kwaliteitscontrole met privacy-safeguards",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#ai-gedreven-kwaliteitscontrole-met-privacy-safeguards",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Een automotive-fabriek gebruikt AI om videofeeds te analyseren van AR-uitgeruste technici die montagecontroles uitvoeren. De AI markeert afwijkingen in real-time, maar alle video wordt geanonimiseerd om gezichten en persoonlijke identificatoren te verwijderen voordat opslag. Alleen samenvattingsdata wordt gedeeld met kwaliteitsteams, en beeldmateriaal wordt verwijderd na 30 dagen tenzij nodig voor incidentonderzoek."}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"remote-assistentie-met-strikte-toegangscontroles",children:["Remote assistentie met strikte toegangscontroles",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#remote-assistentie-met-strikte-toegangscontroles",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Een onderhoudsleider in de energiesector gebruikt AR om veldengineers te verbinden met remote experts. Live videofeeds zijn end-to-end versleuteld, en sessielogs worden bewaard voor audit. Remote experts kunnen alleen toegang krijgen tot de feed tijdens geplande support-vensters en kunnen beeldmateriaal niet opnemen of downloaden zonder expliciete toestemming."}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"In elk geval zijn robuuste cybersecurity- en privacymaatregelen ingebouwd in zowel de technologiestack als de operationele procedures."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"veelvoorkomende-bezwaren-en-beperkingen-adresseren",children:["Veelvoorkomende bezwaren en beperkingen adresseren",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#veelvoorkomende-bezwaren-en-beperkingen-adresseren",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Besluitvormers uiten vaak valide zorgen bij het evalueren van AR- en AI-deployments:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",i(a.li,{children:["
",i(a.p,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:'"We kunnen ons productienetwerk niet riskeren bloot te stellen."'}),n(a.br,{}),"
","Netwerksegmentatie, apparaatverharding en beveiligde gateways maken AR- en AI-verkeer mogelijk zonder kern-OT-systemen te compromitteren."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:["
",i(a.p,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:'"Hoe waarborgen we GDPR- of CCPA-compliance?"'}),n(a.br,{}),"
","Dataminimalisatie, transparante toestemmingsprocessen en duidelijke dataflow-mapping zijn essentieel. Kies leveranciers met sterke track records in industriële compliance."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:["
",i(a.p,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:'"Hoe zit het met content gecreëerd door technici?"'}),n(a.br,{}),"
","Implementeer automatische contentclassificatie, toegangscontroles en retentiebeleid voor gebruikersgegenereerde foto's, video's en notities."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:["
",i(a.p,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:'"Zijn AR-apparaten zelf een zwakke schakel?"'}),n(a.br,{}),"
","Standaardiseer op goedgekeurde apparaten, dwing regelmatige updates af en beperk installatie van ongeautoriseerde apps."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:["
",i(a.p,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:'"Change management is een uitdaging."'}),n(a.br,{}),"
","Betrek IT-, operations- en HSE-teams vroeg. Bied gerichte training en duidelijke escalatiepaden voor beveiligingsincidenten."]}),"
"]}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"wat-actarion-brengt-naar-veilige-ar--en-ai-deployment",children:["Wat ActARion brengt naar veilige AR- en AI-deployment",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#wat-actarion-brengt-naar-veilige-ar--en-ai-deployment",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"ActARion werkt samen met industriële organisaties om AI- en AR-geleide werkvoorschriften te leveren die voldoen aan de hoogste standaarden voor cybersecurity en gegevensprivacy. Onze aanpak omvat:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"End-to-end versleuteling:"})," Alle data, van apparaat tot cloud, is versleuteld met industrie best practices."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Rolgebaseerde toegangscontroles:"})," Alleen geautoriseerd personeel kan digitale werkvoorschriften en bijbehorende data creëren, bewerken of reviewen."]}),"

title: Cybersecurity and data privacy when deploying AR and AI in operations
description: Learn how to address cybersecurity and data privacy challenges when implementing AR and AI in industrial operations. For operations, HSE, and IT leaders.

author: ActARion
body:
const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(a){const r={a:"a",br:"br",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",hr:"hr",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...a.components};return i(e,{children:[i(r.h1,{id:"cybersecurity-and-data-privacy-when-deploying-ar-and-ai-in-operations",children:["Cybersecurity and data privacy when deploying AR and AI in operations",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#cybersecurity-and-data-privacy-when-deploying-ar-and-ai-in-operations",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Augmented reality (AR) and artificial intelligence (AI) are transforming industrial operations. Companies use AR and AI–guided work instructions to digitize inspections, standardize procedures, and accelerate training. But as these tools connect devices, data, and teams, new risks emerge around cybersecurity and data privacy. For operations, HSE, and IT leaders, ensuring that AR and AI deployments are secure is now a non-negotiable part of digital transformation."}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"rising-adoption-of-ar-and-ai-in-industrial-environments",children:["Rising adoption of AR and AI in industrial environments",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#rising-adoption-of-ar-and-ai-in-industrial-environments",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Industrial organizations are under pressure to optimize productivity, maintain high safety standards, and transfer knowledge efficiently. AR and AI–guided work instructions address these needs:"}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",n(r.li,{children:"Field engineers use AR headsets to follow digital SOPs hands-free."}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Maintenance leads leverage AI to flag anomalies during inspections."}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Training managers accelerate onboarding with interactive, real-time guidance."}),"
"]}),"
",i(r.p,{children:["According to ",n(r.a,{href:"https://www.pwc.com/gx/en/issues/technology/ai-analysis.html",children:"PwC"}),", over 70% of industrial companies plan to increase their investment in AI by 2025. AR adoption is also accelerating as hardware becomes more practical and content creation tools mature."]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"But as these technologies move from pilots to production, the attack surface expands. Devices with cameras and microphones, cloud-connected analytics, and real-time data sharing all present new entry points for cyber threats and privacy breaches."}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"why-cybersecurity-and-data-privacy-demand-urgent-attention",children:["Why cybersecurity and data privacy demand urgent attention",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#why-cybersecurity-and-data-privacy-demand-urgent-attention",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Industrial operations handle sensitive information: production parameters, equipment status, safety incidents, and sometimes personal data about technicians. When AR and AI platforms are introduced, the following risks become more pressing:"}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Unauthorized access:"})," AR devices and connected platforms may be targeted for credential theft or unauthorized access attempts."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Data interception:"})," Real-time video, sensor data, and work logs transmitted over networks can be intercepted if not properly encrypted."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Privacy breaches:"})," Devices often collect audio, video, and location data that may be subject to GDPR or other privacy regulations."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Malware and ransomware:"})," AI algorithms and AR devices are potential vectors for malware if not secured and updated regularly."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Loss of operational integrity:"})," Compromised digital work instructions can lead to unsafe procedures or quality escapes."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(r.p,{children:["A ",n(r.a,{href:"https://www.sans.org/white-papers/industrial-cybersecurity-2023-survey/",children:"2023 SANS report"})," found that 40% of industrial organizations experienced a cybersecurity incident impacting operational technology (OT) in the past year. The cost of a breach goes beyond downtime—regulatory fines, reputational damage, and loss of intellectual property are real risks."]}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"how-ar-and-aiguided-work-instructions-introduce-new-security-challenges",children:["How AR and AI–guided work instructions introduce new security challenges",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-ar-and-aiguided-work-instructions-introduce-new-security-challenges",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Traditional IT and OT systems in industrial environments are often siloed, with clear boundaries and controls. AR and AI change this in several ways:"}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Device proliferation:"})," AR headsets, tablets, and mobile devices multiply the number of endpoints needing protection."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Cloud connectivity:"})," Many AR and AI platforms rely on cloud-based analytics and storage, raising questions about data residency and third-party access."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"User-generated content:"})," Teams may upload photos, videos, or notes to digital work instructions, increasing the volume and sensitivity of stored data."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Integration complexity:"})," Connecting AR SOPs to legacy systems, asset databases, or ERP tools introduces integration points that must also be secured."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Each new interface or integration is a potential vulnerability. Without robust governance, these risks can quickly outpace the benefits of digitization."}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"key-requirements-for-secure-and-compliant-ar-and-ai-deployments",children:["Key requirements for secure and compliant AR and AI deployments",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#key-requirements-for-secure-and-compliant-ar-and-ai-deployments",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Operations and IT leaders must work together to ensure that AR and AI–guided work instructions meet strict security and privacy standards. Key requirements include:"}),"
",i(r.h3,{id:"device-and-network-security",children:["Device and network security",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#device-and-network-security",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",n(r.li,{children:"Require strong authentication (e.g., multi-factor authentication) for all AR and AI devices."}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Enforce regular software updates and device patching."}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Use secure Wi-Fi, VPN, or private 5G networks for on-site connectivity."}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Segment AR and AI traffic from critical OT networks where possible."}),"
"]}),"
",i(r.h3,{id:"data-protection-and-privacy",children:["Data protection and privacy",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#data-protection-and-privacy",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",n(r.li,{children:"Encrypt all data at rest and in transit, especially video, audio, and sensor streams."}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Store sensitive data in secure, compliant cloud environments or on-premises as needed."}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Implement access controls and audit logs to track who accessed or modified digital work instructions."}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Minimize data collection to what is necessary for operations or compliance."}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Anonymize or pseudonymize personal data wherever feasible."}),"
"]}),"
",i(r.h3,{id:"governance-and-compliance",children:["Governance and compliance",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#governance-and-compliance",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",n(r.li,{children:"Map data flows and storage locations for all AR and AI–enabled processes."}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Conduct privacy impact assessments, especially if handling personal data or data subject to GDPR, CCPA, or local laws."}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Maintain clear policies on data retention, deletion, and subject access requests."}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Train teams on secure device use and reporting suspicious activity."}),"
"]}),"
",i(r.h3,{id:"vendor-due-diligence",children:["Vendor due diligence",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#vendor-due-diligence",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",n(r.li,{children:"Evaluate AR and AI platform vendors for security certifications (e.g., ISO 27001, SOC 2)."}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Review third-party subprocessor lists and data protection agreements."}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Require regular penetration testing and vulnerability disclosures."}),"
"]}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"practical-use-cases-secure-ar-and-ai-in-action",children:["Practical use cases: Secure AR and AI in action",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#practical-use-cases-secure-ar-and-ai-in-action",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"To illustrate what secure deployment looks like, consider these real-world scenarios:"}),"
",i(r.h3,{id:"digitizing-safety-inspections-with-ar-sops",children:["Digitizing safety inspections with AR SOPs",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#digitizing-safety-inspections-with-ar-sops",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"A European chemical manufacturer equips operators with AR glasses to conduct daily safety inspections. The AR SOPs guide each step, capture photos, and log results directly to a secure cloud. Only authorized supervisors can review inspection data, and all transmissions are encrypted. Device access is restricted to company-issued credentials, and logs are retained per regulatory requirements."}),"
",i(r.h3,{id:"ai-powered-quality-control-with-privacy-safeguards",children:["AI-powered quality control with privacy safeguards",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#ai-powered-quality-control-with-privacy-safeguards",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"An automotive plant uses AI to analyze video feeds from AR-equipped technicians performing assembly checks. The AI flags deviations in real time, but all video is anonymized to remove faces and personal identifiers before storage. Only summary data is shared with quality teams, and footage is deleted after 30 days unless needed for incident investigation."}),"
",i(r.h3,{id:"remote-assistance-with-strict-access-controls",children:["Remote assistance with strict access controls",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#remote-assistance-with-strict-access-controls",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"A maintenance lead in the energy sector uses AR to connect field engineers with remote experts. Live video feeds are end-to-end encrypted, and session logs are kept for audit. Remote experts can only access the feed during scheduled support windows and cannot record or download footage without explicit consent."}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"In each case, robust cybersecurity and privacy measures are built into both the technology stack and the operating procedures."}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"addressing-common-objections-and-limitations",children:["Addressing common objections and limitations",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#addressing-common-objections-and-limitations",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Decision makers often raise valid concerns when evaluating AR and AI deployments:"}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",i(r.li,{children:["
",i(r.p,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"“We can’t risk exposing our production network.”"}),n(r.br,{}),"
","Network segmentation, device hardening, and secure gateways allow AR and AI traffic without compromising core OT systems."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:["
",i(r.p,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"“How do we ensure GDPR or CCPA compliance?”"}),n(r.br,{}),"
","Data minimization, transparent consent processes, and clear data flow mapping are essential. Choose vendors with strong track records in industrial compliance."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:["
",i(r.p,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"“What about content created by technicians?”"}),n(r.br,{}),"
","Implement automatic content classification, access controls, and retention policies for user-generated photos, videos, and notes."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:["
",i(r.p,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"“Are AR devices themselves a weak link?”"}),n(r.br,{}),"
","Standardize on approved devices, enforce regular updates, and restrict installation of unauthorized apps."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:["
",i(r.p,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"“Change management is a challenge.”"}),n(r.br,{}),"
","Involve IT, operations, and HSE teams early. Provide targeted training and clear escalation paths for security incidents."]}),"
"]}),"
"]}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"what-actarion-brings-to-secure-ar-and-ai-deployment",children:["What ActARion brings to secure AR and AI deployment",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#what-actarion-brings-to-secure-ar-and-ai-deployment",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"ActARion works with industrial organizations to deliver AI and AR–guided work instructions that meet the highest standards for cybersecurity and data privacy. Our approach includes:"}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"End-to-end encryption:"})," All data, from device to cloud, is encrypted using industry best practices."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Role-based access controls:"})," Only authorized personnel can create, edit, or review digital work instructions and associated data."]}),"

",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Privacy by design:"})," Personal data is minimized, anonymized, or excluded wherever possible; privacy impact assessments are standard."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Integration with existing IT/OT security:"})," We align with your network policies, device management, and incident response procedures."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Change management support:"})," We support your teams with training, documentation, and secure onboarding processes."]}),"

",n(r.p,{children:"By partnering with ActARion, you gain a credible, experienced provider who understands the realities of industrial cybersecurity and compliance."}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"explore-secure-ar-and-ai-work-instructions-in-your-operations",children:["Explore secure AR and AI work instructions in your operations",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#explore-secure-ar-and-ai-work-instructions-in-your-operations",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Securing AR and AI–guided work instructions is essential for safe, productive, and compliant industrial operations. const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(a){const t={a:"a",blockquote:"blockquote",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...a.components};return i(e,{children:[i(t.h1,{id:"data-and-analytics-from-ar-instructions-what-to-measure-and-how-to-use-it",children:["Data and analytics from AR instructions: what to measure and how to use it",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#data-and-analytics-from-ar-instructions-what-to-measure-and-how-to-use-it",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Data from AR-guided work instructions is transforming how industrial leaders manage productivity, safety, and training. With the right analytics, operations managers, HSE leads, and maintenance teams can pinpoint inefficiencies, verify compliance, and continuously improve processes. But what data should you measure, and how do you turn it into actionable insight?"}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"why-data-from-ar-instructions-matters-now",children:["Why data from AR instructions matters now",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#why-data-from-ar-instructions-matters-now",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Industrial businesses face increasing pressure to maximize uptime, ensure regulatory compliance, and reduce incidents—all while managing a workforce with varying skills and experience. Traditional work instructions, whether paper-based or static digital files, rarely provide feedback on how tasks are performed in the field. This makes it hard to identify where procedures break down or where additional training is needed."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"AI and AR–guided work instructions change this dynamic. Every step, confirmation, and user interaction can be logged and analyzed. This provides a new layer of operational visibility, making it possible to:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Identify bottlenecks and deviations in real time"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Verify that SOPs are followed as intended"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Detect knowledge gaps before they lead to incidents"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Optimize training and onboarding for new technicians"}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.p,{children:["These capabilities are especially relevant as industrial companies respond to workforce turnover, stricter regulatory scrutiny, and the need for continuous improvement. According to McKinsey, data-driven operations can increase productivity in manufacturing environments by up to 30% (",n(t.a,{href:"https://www.mckinsey.com/capabilities/operations/our-insights/the-potential-for-ai-in-industrial-operations",children:"source"}),"). AR SOPs and digital work instructions are a key enabler for this shift."]}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"what-to-measure-key-metrics-from-ar-work-instructions",children:["What to measure: key metrics from AR work instructions",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#what-to-measure-key-metrics-from-ar-work-instructions",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Not every metric is equally valuable. The most effective analytics focus on operational performance, compliance, safety, and workforce development. Here are the main categories decision makers should track:"}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"1-task-completion-and-cycle-time",children:["1. Task completion and cycle time",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#1-task-completion-and-cycle-time",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Step-by-step duration:"})," Time spent on each instruction step, highlighting bottlenecks."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Total process time:"})," End-to-end duration for critical procedures."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Time variance:"})," Comparison across shifts, teams, or locations."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.p,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Why it matters:"})," Consistent delays often indicate unclear instructions, equipment issues, or skill gaps."]}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"2-compliance-and-deviation-tracking",children:["2. Compliance and deviation tracking",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#2-compliance-and-deviation-tracking",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Step confirmations:"})," Whether each step was completed and acknowledged."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Skipped steps:"})," Frequency and context for omitted actions."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Deviation logs:"})," Manual entries or flagged deviations from SOPs."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.p,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Why it matters:"})," Skipped or rushed steps are a leading cause of safety incidents and quality escapes."]}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"3-error-and-incident-capture",children:["3. Error and incident capture",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#3-error-and-incident-capture",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["

",n(t.p,{children:"Industrial training is at a turning point. These technologies, when used together, equip technicians and operators with the tools they need to work smarter, safer, and faster."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"why-traditional-industrial-training-models-are-reaching-their-limits",children:["Why traditional industrial training models are reaching their limits",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#why-traditional-industrial-training-models-are-reaching-their-limits",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Industrial environments are more complex than ever. Equipment is sophisticated, processes are tightly regulated, and mistakes can have significant safety or financial consequences. Yet, many training programs still rely on:"}),"

",n(t.li,{children:"Classroom theory sessions detached from real equipment"}),"

items.title: Why hands free working matters now
What hands free working with smart glasses can do
When do smart glasses really add value?
1. Work requires both hands for safety or precision
2. Environments are hazardous, sterile, or regulated
3. Procedures are complex, variable, or high-stakes
4. Onboarding and training need to be accelerated

",n(a.p,{children:"Augmented reality (AR) work instructions are becoming standard in industrial environments, but one question remains critical: how to keep AR content up to date when processes change frequently? For operations managers, HSE leads, and training specialists, outdated instructions can undermine safety, efficiency, and compliance. Keeping digital work instructions accurate and aligned with the latest procedures is now a frontline concern."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"the-challenge-process-change-and-the-risk-of-outdated-ar-content",children:["The challenge: process change and the risk of outdated AR content",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#the-challenge-process-change-and-the-risk-of-outdated-ar-content",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"

",i(a.h2,{id:"why-traditional-content-management-falls-short",children:["Why traditional content management falls short",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#why-traditional-content-management-falls-short",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"

",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Slow feedback loops:"})," Operators’ suggestions or process tweaks take weeks to reach content creators."]}),"
